included_members.idea_text: A cleaning chamber where garments are introduced and suspended on a precisely controlled air cushion (an "air film") generated from below. This eliminates friction and mechanical wear. While suspended, targeted, high-velocity air nozzles (acting as siphons or localized vacuums) are directed at the garment from above, actively lifting and extracting dry dust, lint, and superficial grime from the fabric fibers, collecting them in a filter system, all without water or direct contact.
included_members.abstraction: Directed high-velocity airflow and localized suction for particle extraction: Targeted jets and localized vacuum/siphon actions lift lint, dust and superficial grime from fibers and entrain them into a removal stream.
included_members.label: Directed high-velocity airflow and localized suction for particle extraction
included_members.description: Targeted jets and localized vacuum/siphon actions lift lint, dust and superficial grime from fibers and entrain them into a removal stream.
included_members.explanation: High-velocity airflow and suction lift and remove lint/dust—dry aerodynamic particle removal.

included_members.idea_text: A cleaning chamber where garments are introduced and suspended on a precisely controlled air cushion (an "air film") generated from below. This eliminates friction and mechanical wear. While suspended, targeted, high-velocity air nozzles (acting as siphons or localized vacuums) are directed at the garment from above, actively lifting and extracting dry dust, lint, and superficial grime from the fabric fibers, collecting them in a filter system, all without water or direct contact.
included_members.abstraction: Controlled air-cushion support (air film): A precisely regulated upward airflow layer that suspends textiles to eliminate contact forces and enable unobstructed exposure of surfaces.
included_members.label: Controlled air-cushion support (air film)
included_members.description: A precisely regulated upward airflow layer that suspends textiles to eliminate contact forces and enable unobstructed exposure of surfaces.
included_members.explanation: Air-cushion suspends textiles to enable airflow-based cleaning—still an aerodynamic/mechanical dry removal approach.

included_members.idea_text: A cleaning chamber where garments are introduced and suspended on a precisely controlled air cushion (an "air film") generated from below. This eliminates friction and mechanical wear. While suspended, targeted, high-velocity air nozzles (acting as siphons or localized vacuums) are directed at the garment from above, actively lifting and extracting dry dust, lint, and superficial grime from the fabric fibers, collecting them in a filter system, all without water or direct contact.
included_members.abstraction: Filtration and particle collection subsystem: Mechanisms to separate, trap and store airborne particulates removed by the airflow (filters, cyclones, bins), preventing recirculation.
included_members.label: Filtration and particle collection subsystem
included_members.description: Mechanisms to separate, trap and store airborne particulates removed by the airflow (filters, cyclones, bins), preventing recirculation.
included_members.explanation: Filters/cyclones/bins capture airborne particulates extracted by airflow—dry particle removal and containment.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet or tumbling drum equipped with a heating and cooling system to create a controlled temperature gradient across the fabric surface in a dry environment. As garments are gently tumbled or suspended, the temperature gradient induces thermophoretic forces that gently drive fine dust, lint, and superficial particulate dirt away from the warmer fabric surface towards a colder collection plate or filter, effectively removing dry contaminants without water.
included_members.abstraction: Gentle agitation or suspension to expose contaminants: Provide relative motion or orientation (tumbling, rotation, suspension) to present surfaces, reduce contact adhesion, and allow particulate migration driven by the thermal gradient.
included_members.label: Gentle agitation or suspension to expose contaminants
included_members.description: Provide relative motion or orientation (tumbling, rotation, suspension) to present surfaces, reduce contact adhesion, and allow particulate migration driven by the thermal gradient.
included_members.explanation: Uses gentle mechanical motion (tumbling/rotation/suspension) to loosen/expose dry particulates for removal.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet or tumbling drum equipped with a heating and cooling system to create a controlled temperature gradient across the fabric surface in a dry environment. As garments are gently tumbled or suspended, the temperature gradient induces thermophoretic forces that gently drive fine dust, lint, and superficial particulate dirt away from the warmer fabric surface towards a colder collection plate or filter, effectively removing dry contaminants without water.
included_members.abstraction: Sealed system with cold collection and filtration: Confine the process in a dry enclosure and deliver one or more cold capture surfaces or filters (and optional airflow control) to intercept and hold particles moved by thermophoresis.
included_members.label: Sealed system with cold collection and filtration
included_members.description: Confine the process in a dry enclosure and deliver one or more cold capture surfaces or filters (and optional airflow control) to intercept and hold particles moved by thermophoresis.
included_members.explanation: Enclosed dry system with cold capture surfaces/filters to intercept removed particles—dry particulate extraction/containment.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet where an internal electric field generates a controlled "ion wind" or electrohydrodynamic flow. This silent, gentle, localized air current is directed across the fabric surfaces, physically dislodging dry dust, lint, and carrying away odor molecules without any moving mechanical parts. The dislodged particles and odors are then collected by an integrated filter and purification system, providing a water-free and gentle cleaning method.
included_members.abstraction: Directed surface airflow delivery: Channeling and shaping the induced airflow into localized, controlled streams or jets targeted at fabric surfaces to maximize detachment efficacy while remaining gentle.
included_members.label: Directed surface airflow delivery
included_members.description: Channeling and shaping the induced airflow into localized, controlled streams or jets targeted at fabric surfaces to maximize detachment efficacy while remaining gentle.
included_members.explanation: Uses directed airflow jets to physically dislodge particles/volatiles from textiles—dry aerodynamic removal.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet where an internal electric field generates a controlled "ion wind" or electrohydrodynamic flow. This silent, gentle, localized air current is directed across the fabric surfaces, physically dislodging dry dust, lint, and carrying away odor molecules without any moving mechanical parts. The dislodged particles and odors are then collected by an integrated filter and purification system, providing a water-free and gentle cleaning method.
included_members.abstraction: Integrated particulate/volatile capture & purification: Downstream systems that trap, filter, or chemically/photocatalytically neutralize the dislodged particles and odor molecules to prevent recirculation.
included_members.label: Integrated particulate/volatile capture & purification
included_members.description: Downstream systems that trap, filter, or chemically/photocatalytically neutralize the dislodged particles and odor molecules to prevent recirculation.
included_members.explanation: Captures dislodged particles/odors with filtration/purification to prevent redeposition—part of dry removal system.

included_members.idea_text: Garments are woven with a percentage of specialized, micro-scale stimuli-responsive fibers (e.g., pH or humidity-sensitive polymers). When the garment is exposed to a minimal, fine mist of water with a specific pH, these embedded fibers swell, physically pushing outwards and dislodging dirt particles from the fabric structure. A subsequent change (e.g., mild heating or pH neutralization) causes the fibers to shrink, releasing the loosened dirt, which is then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration system, achieving cleaning with very low water input.
included_members.abstraction: Post-actuation particle capture via airflow and filtration: A downstream system that collects and contains particles dislodged by actuation using gentle directed airflow and particulate filters rather than liquid flushing.
included_members.label: Post-actuation particle capture via airflow and filtration
included_members.description: A downstream system that collects and contains particles dislodged by actuation using gentle directed airflow and particulate filters rather than liquid flushing.
included_members.explanation: Uses airflow plus filtration to collect loosened particles without rinsing—dry mechanical/aerodynamic extraction.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet where clothes are suspended. Compressed air is fed into an array of miniature vortex tubes directed at the garments. The resulting high-velocity, temperature-differentiated air streams create targeted aerodynamic forces to dislodge dry dust and lint (mechanical cleaning) and simultaneously generate localized thermophoretic effects, pushing fine particles away from the fabric towards a collection filter. This provides a dry, water-free, and energy-efficient cleaning process.
included_members.abstraction: Targeted temperature-differentiated high-velocity air streams producing aerodynamic and thermophoretic particle removal: Use focused jets of air that combine mechanical forces (shear/impulse) to dislodge dust/lint and thermal gradients to bias movement of fine particles away from fabric toward a collector; the directed, temperature-differentiated flows are the functionally central mechanism that performs the cleaning and transport.
included_members.label: Targeted temperature-differentiated high-velocity air streams producing aerodynamic and thermophoretic particle removal
included_members.description: Use focused jets of air that combine mechanical forces (shear/impulse) to dislodge dust/lint and thermal gradients to bias movement of fine particles away from fabric toward a collector; the directed, temperature-differentiated flows are the functionally central mechanism that performs the cleaning and transport.
included_members.explanation: Uses high-velocity air jets plus thermal bias to dislodge and transport dry particles to a collector—dry aerodynamic/mechanical removal.

included_members.idea_text: A specialized garment refresh chamber where clothes are briefly exposed to a controlled, low-energy electron beam. The electron beam's energy is tuned to target and disrupt the molecular bonds of organic dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on the fabric surface. These contaminants are then converted into volatile byproducts or easily detachable fragments that are removed by a gentle vacuum system, providing a deep, dry, and chemical-free surface cleaning and deodorization, minimizing the need for water washes.
included_members.abstraction: Gentle vacuum/airflow removal of byproducts and fragments: Use low-pressure suction or directed airflow to extract volatile decomposition products and loose fragments from the garment surface and transport them to filters or exhaust pathways.
included_members.label: Gentle vacuum/airflow removal of byproducts and fragments
included_members.description: Use low-pressure suction or directed airflow to extract volatile decomposition products and loose fragments from the garment surface and transport them to filters or exhaust pathways.
included_members.explanation: Removes detached fragments/volatile byproducts via suction/airflow—dry physical extraction.

included_members.idea_text: A garment cleaning station equipped with a low-power, pulsed laser system. Optical sensors identify soiled areas, and the laser is precisely tuned (wavelength, pulse energy) to be selectively absorbed by common dirt, oils, or stain chromophores. The absorbed energy causes rapid, localized micro-vaporization or thermal decomposition of the contaminant, effectively "ablating" it from the fabric surface without heating or damaging the surrounding fibers. A gentle vacuum collects the resulting microscopic debris, providing an extremely targeted, water-free, and residue-free cleaning method.
included_members.abstraction: Localized vacuum collection of debris: Apply gentle suction at the treatment site to collect particulate and vaporization products generated by the energy treatment, preventing re-deposition.
included_members.label: Localized vacuum collection of debris
included_members.description: Apply gentle suction at the treatment site to collect particulate and vaporization products generated by the energy treatment, preventing re-deposition.
included_members.explanation: Localized vacuum collection is dry mechanical/aerodynamic extraction of debris.

included_members.idea_text: A targeted spray or fine mist system that applies a fabric-safe mixture of biofilm-dispersing enzymes, mild natural dispersants, or lytic bacteriophages onto garments. This treatment specifically breaks down the sticky matrix of microbial biofilms and the embedded dirt/odor compounds, allowing them to be easily wiped away with a damp cloth or lifted by a gentle air current and filtration system, significantly reducing the need for bulk water washing to eliminate persistent smells and grime.
included_members.abstraction: Low-moisture removal and capture: Methods for removing or collecting loosened contaminants without full washing, such as localized wiping or airflow with filtration.
included_members.label: Low-moisture removal and capture
included_members.description: Methods for removing or collecting loosened contaminants without full washing, such as localized wiping or airflow with filtration.
included_members.explanation: Wiping/airflow with filtration to pick up loosened contaminants is dry mechanical/aerodynamic removal.

included_members.idea_text: A specialized laundry drum or cabinet with embedded micro-electrodes near the fabric surface. When clothes are present, a precisely controlled, short, high-energy electrical pulse is applied. This generates localized, micro-scale mechanical shockwaves within the fabric itself or at the fabric-dirt interface, effectively breaking the adhesive bonds of embedded dirt and grime without damaging the fibers. The dislodged particles are then removed by a gentle vacuum and filtration system, providing a water-free cleaning method that targets deeply embedded contaminants.
included_members.abstraction: Vacuum-driven particle extraction and filtration: Use gentle directed airflow to lift, transport, and capture dislodged particles into a filtration/collection subsystem for removal and containment.
included_members.label: Vacuum-driven particle extraction and filtration
included_members.description: Use gentle directed airflow to lift, transport, and capture dislodged particles into a filtration/collection subsystem for removal and containment.
included_members.explanation: Vacuum/airflow transport and filtration of dislodged particles is dry mechanical/aerodynamic removal.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet designed to gently heat clothes to a precisely controlled, low temperature in a dry, inert atmosphere. This controlled heating causes volatile odor-causing compounds, body oils, and light organic residues embedded in the fabric to desorb (vaporize) from the fibers. A continuous, gentle airflow then carries these volatilized contaminants to a filtration or catalytic oxidation unit for capture and safe breakdown, effectively refreshing and deodorizing garments without the use of water or chemicals, extending wear time between wet washes.
included_members.abstraction: Airflow-mediated transport and capture/neutralization: Use continuous, gentle airflow to carry desorbed species away from textiles to filtration and/or catalytic systems that trap or chemically break down contaminants.
included_members.label: Airflow-mediated transport and capture/neutralization
included_members.description: Use continuous, gentle airflow to carry desorbed species away from textiles to filtration and/or catalytic systems that trap or chemically break down contaminants.
included_members.explanation: Uses airflow to transport liberated contaminants to filters/catalysts, aligning with aerodynamic removal and extraction via air handling.

included_members.idea_text: A highly specialized garment cleaning station equipped with a low-energy, broad, non-damaging ion beam. Optical sensors identify and map individual dirt particles or stains. The ion beam is then directed to these specific micro-regions, where the kinetic energy of the ions physically dislodges and sputters away the contaminant molecules from the fabric surface without damaging the fibers. A gentle vacuum system collects the sputtered debris, providing an ultra-precise, water-free, and residue-free spot cleaning method.
included_members.abstraction: Localized vacuum-based debris capture: Apply a gentle, localized suction and filtration system positioned to capture sputtered or dislodged material immediately upon removal.
included_members.label: Localized vacuum-based debris capture
included_members.description: Apply a gentle, localized suction and filtration system positioned to capture sputtered or dislodged material immediately upon removal.
included_members.explanation: Uses localized vacuum/suction to capture dislodged debris—dry extraction of particulates.

included_members.idea_text: Design a laundry drum with an internal lining composed of a dense array of very fine, compliant, and electrically charged polymeric filaments or a specialized mesh. As clothes tumble, these filaments gently brush against the fabric, and the static charge passively attracts and entangles dry dust, lint, and pet hair. The collected debris adheres to the filaments, which are periodically retracted and vibrated or subjected to a reverse charge to release the accumulated dirt into a separate collection bin, providing a gentle, water-free dry cleaning and de-linting process.
included_members.abstraction: Compliant charged capture surface: A dense array of soft, flexible, contacting elements that generate or hold an electrostatic attraction while mechanically brushing textiles to capture particulates.
included_members.label: Compliant charged capture surface
included_members.description: A dense array of soft, flexible, contacting elements that generate or hold an electrostatic attraction while mechanically brushing textiles to capture particulates.
included_members.explanation: Electrostatic brushing/contact capture removes dry particulates without water.

included_members.idea_text: Design a laundry drum with an internal lining composed of a dense array of very fine, compliant, and electrically charged polymeric filaments or a specialized mesh. As clothes tumble, these filaments gently brush against the fabric, and the static charge passively attracts and entangles dry dust, lint, and pet hair. The collected debris adheres to the filaments, which are periodically retracted and vibrated or subjected to a reverse charge to release the accumulated dirt into a separate collection bin, providing a gentle, water-free dry cleaning and de-linting process.
included_members.abstraction: Active release and waste transfer mechanism: A periodic actuation and/or electrical reversal step that detaches accumulated debris from the capture surface and deposits it into a separate collection bin.
included_members.label: Active release and waste transfer mechanism
included_members.description: A periodic actuation and/or electrical reversal step that detaches accumulated debris from the capture surface and deposits it into a separate collection bin.
included_members.explanation: Releases collected debris from the capture surface into a bin—part of dry particulate removal process.

included_members.idea_text: Design a laundry drum with an internal lining composed of a dense array of very fine, compliant, and electrically charged polymeric filaments or a specialized mesh. As clothes tumble, these filaments gently brush against the fabric, and the static charge passively attracts and entangles dry dust, lint, and pet hair. The collected debris adheres to the filaments, which are periodically retracted and vibrated or subjected to a reverse charge to release the accumulated dirt into a separate collection bin, providing a gentle, water-free dry cleaning and de-linting process.
included_members.abstraction: Low-abrasion contact design: Using material compliance and fine geometry to minimize shear and abrasion on fabric while enabling contact necessary for particulate pickup.
included_members.label: Low-abrasion contact design
included_members.description: Using material compliance and fine geometry to minimize shear and abrasion on fabric while enabling contact necessary for particulate pickup.
included_members.explanation: Designs gentle contact/geometry for brushing pickup—mechanical dry particle removal emphasis.

included_members.idea_text: A flat cleaning surface or a drum lining integrated with an array of microscopic, fabric-safe MEMS actuators. When a garment makes contact, optical sensors identify individual dirt particles. The micro-actuators then precisely extend or vibrate locally, gently lifting or dislodging specific dirt particles from the fabric fibers. These particles are then drawn away by a localized micro-vacuum system, enabling highly targeted, dry, and extremely gentle particulate removal from clothing without water.
included_members.abstraction: Micro-scale localized actuation: An array of tiny actuators that apply precise, local motion (extension, vibration) to dislodge particles from individual fiber sites.
included_members.label: Micro-scale localized actuation
included_members.description: An array of tiny actuators that apply precise, local motion (extension, vibration) to dislodge particles from individual fiber sites.
included_members.explanation: Micro-actuators mechanically dislodge particles from fibers—dry mechanical removal.

included_members.idea_text: A flat cleaning surface or a drum lining integrated with an array of microscopic, fabric-safe MEMS actuators. When a garment makes contact, optical sensors identify individual dirt particles. The micro-actuators then precisely extend or vibrate locally, gently lifting or dislodging specific dirt particles from the fabric fibers. These particles are then drawn away by a localized micro-vacuum system, enabling highly targeted, dry, and extremely gentle particulate removal from clothing without water.
included_members.abstraction: Localized suction-based particle removal: Apply localized vacuum to capture and transport dislodged particles away from the fabric surface.
included_members.label: Localized suction-based particle removal
included_members.description: Apply localized vacuum to capture and transport dislodged particles away from the fabric surface.
included_members.explanation: Localized suction captures dislodged particles—dry extraction/particle removal.

included_members.idea_text: A garment cleaning system where clothes are briefly exposed to a very fine mist of a fabric-safe, non-toxic, supersaturated crystalline salt solution. Cycles of controlled humidity reduction and re-humidification are then applied in a dry chamber. As the salt crystals grow within the fabric pores and around dirt particles, they exert micro-mechanical stresses. When humidity changes, they re-crystallize or shrink, causing embedded dirt to physically detach from the fibers. The loosened dirt and salt residue are then removed by a gentle vacuum and filtration system, achieving cleaning with minimal water and no harsh chemicals.
included_members.abstraction: Gentle particulate and residue removal via suction and filtration: Collect detached particles and any residual solids using low-agitation vacuuming and filtration rather than rinsing or immersion.
included_members.label: Gentle particulate and residue removal via suction and filtration
included_members.description: Collect detached particles and any residual solids using low-agitation vacuuming and filtration rather than rinsing or immersion.
included_members.explanation: Removes detached solids by vacuum suction and filtration without rinsing, i.e., dry extraction of particulates.

included_members.idea_text: Garments are manufactured with embedded or surface-applied microscopic, optically responsive elements (e.g., plasmonic nanoparticles or specialized polymer fibers). When placed in a dry cleaning chamber and illuminated with precisely tuned, non-damaging light wavelengths, these elements preferentially absorb energy. This causes rapid, localized micro-thermal expansion and contraction or phase change directly at the fabric-dirt interface, physically agitating and dislodging dirt particles. A gentle airflow then removes the loosened particles, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method leveraging engineered fabric properties.
included_members.abstraction: Controlled airflow-based particle removal: Apply a gentle, directed airflow to carry away loosened particles from the fabric surface into filters or collectors without wetting.
included_members.label: Controlled airflow-based particle removal
included_members.description: Apply a gentle, directed airflow to carry away loosened particles from the fabric surface into filters or collectors without wetting.
included_members.explanation: Uses directed airflow to carry away loosened particles into collectors—dry aerodynamic removal.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet with internal curved surfaces and precisely angled air nozzles designed to exploit the Coandă effect. A continuous, laminar sheet of high-velocity air is generated and directed to flow smoothly over the garments. This non-turbulent, wall-attached airflow creates a gentle, continuous shear force across the fabric surfaces, effectively lifting and carrying away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial particulate matter without harsh mechanical contact. The dirt-laden air is then silently directed into a high-efficiency filter system, providing a very gentle, water-free cleaning and deodorizing method.
included_members.abstraction: Coandă-driven laminar air-sheet generation: Produce a continuous, wall-attached, high-velocity laminar sheet of air using geometry and nozzle orientation that leverage the Coandă effect.
included_members.label: Coandă-driven laminar air-sheet generation
included_members.description: Produce a continuous, wall-attached, high-velocity laminar sheet of air using geometry and nozzle orientation that leverage the Coandă effect.
included_members.explanation: Generates a high-velocity laminar air sheet to remove debris—dry aerodynamic particulate removal.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet with internal curved surfaces and precisely angled air nozzles designed to exploit the Coandă effect. A continuous, laminar sheet of high-velocity air is generated and directed to flow smoothly over the garments. This non-turbulent, wall-attached airflow creates a gentle, continuous shear force across the fabric surfaces, effectively lifting and carrying away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial particulate matter without harsh mechanical contact. The dirt-laden air is then silently directed into a high-efficiency filter system, providing a very gentle, water-free cleaning and deodorizing method.
included_members.abstraction: Sustained, non-turbulent surface shear: maintain a non-turbulent, wall-attached airflow that applies gentle but persistent shear across fabric surfaces to detach dust, lint, and hair.
included_members.label: Sustained, non-turbulent surface shear
included_members.description: maintain a non-turbulent, wall-attached airflow that applies gentle but persistent shear across fabric surfaces to detach dust, lint, and hair.
included_members.explanation: Uses sustained laminar surface shear to detach lint/dust without contact—dry airflow-based removal.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet with internal curved surfaces and precisely angled air nozzles designed to exploit the Coandă effect. A continuous, laminar sheet of high-velocity air is generated and directed to flow smoothly over the garments. This non-turbulent, wall-attached airflow creates a gentle, continuous shear force across the fabric surfaces, effectively lifting and carrying away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial particulate matter without harsh mechanical contact. The dirt-laden air is then silently directed into a high-efficiency filter system, providing a very gentle, water-free cleaning and deodorizing method.
included_members.abstraction: Directed extraction into high-efficiency filtration: Channel the particle-bearing air stream into a filtration and odor-removal subsystem to capture entrained contaminants.
included_members.label: Directed extraction into high-efficiency filtration
included_members.description: Channel the particle-bearing air stream into a filtration and odor-removal subsystem to capture entrained contaminants.
included_members.explanation: Captures particle-bearing air via high-efficiency filtration—part of dry extraction/collection of particulates.

included_members.idea_text: A controlled environment cabinet or low-humidity wash chamber that applies a fine, fabric-safe mist containing targeted fungal enzymes or specific fungal spore extracts. These enzymes, under optimized temperature and humidity conditions, specifically target and degrade stubborn organic stains (e.g., grass, wine, oil) and complex odor-causing compounds embedded in fabric. This breaks the stains down into smaller, water-soluble, or volatile molecules that are easily wiped away or dissipated by gentle airflow, significantly reducing the need for bulk water washing and harsh chemicals for tough stains.
included_members.abstraction: Removal via volatility/solubility and gentle airflow/wiping: Evaporate volatile breakdown products and solubilize fragments so they can be dissipated by low-velocity airflow or removed with gentle wiping/absorbents instead of heavy rinsing.
included_members.label: Removal via volatility/solubility and gentle airflow/wiping
included_members.description: Evaporate volatile breakdown products and solubilize fragments so they can be dissipated by low-velocity airflow or removed with gentle wiping/absorbents instead of heavy rinsing.
included_members.explanation: Removes breakdown products using gentle airflow/wiping rather than rinsing—non-immersion physical removal/venting after treatment.

nodes.name: Dry chemical/biological decontamination (oxidation, plasma, irradiation, enzymes/microbes)
nodes.description: Chemically/biologically transform odors/organics/microbes on textiles without washing in liquid.
idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet with internal surfaces coated with or containing encapsulated, fabric-safe quantum dots. The cabinet is equipped with specific light sources (e.g., visible LED light). When illuminated, the quantum dots efficiently generate highly reactive species that break down odor molecules, volatile organic compounds, and light organic soiling directly on the fabric surface. This provides a dry, chemical-free, and water-free method for refreshing garments, potentially using lower energy light sources and offering superior catalytic efficiency compared to traditional photocatalysts like TiO2.

A controlled environment cabinet or low-humidity wash chamber that introduces a fine mist containing beneficial, fabric-safe microbes. These microbes, under optimal conditions of temperature and humidity, "consume" odor-causing compounds and light organic soiling on garments, effectively cleaning them over a gentle, longer cycle with minimal water input.

A garment "freshener" cabinet with internal surfaces coated with a TiO2 catalyst and equipped with UV-A light sources. Clothes are hung inside, and the PCO process continuously breaks down odor molecules and airborne contaminants, providing a dry, chemical-free, and water-free method for refreshing garments and extending wear.

A garment refreshing cabinet equipped with a DBD plasma generator. Clothes are exposed to the ozone and reactive oxygen/nitrogen species produced by the DBD. These species effectively break down odor molecules, volatile organic compounds, and microbial contaminants on the fabric surface without direct contact, heat, or water, providing dry sanitization and deodorization.

A garment refresh chamber where clothes are exposed to a specific low-temperature plasma (e.g., derived from oxygen or hydrogen precursor gases). This plasma generates energetic reactive species tuned to gently react with and break down organic residues (body oils, odors, superficial grime) on the fabric surface. These contaminants are converted into volatile byproducts that are then vacuumed away, providing a deep, dry clean at a molecular level without water or harsh chemicals, thereby extending garment life.

A smart wardrobe or garment cabinet that maintains a precisely controlled, low-oxygen (hypoxic) internal atmosphere. By reducing the oxygen concentration around garments, the growth and metabolic activity of odor-causing bacteria and fungi are significantly inhibited, effectively preventing the development of unpleasant smells and extending the freshness of clothes without washing or chemical deodorizers, thus reducing water usage.

Integrate a cold plasma generator into a laundry appliance or a dedicated garment cabinet. Clothes are exposed to plasma, which effectively breaks down odor-causing compounds and sanitizes the fabric, extending wear time between full washes and significantly reducing water consumption.

A targeted handheld device or a small chamber with specialized electrodes. Garments, or specific soiled areas, are exposed to a minimal film of a slightly conductive, fabric-safe electrolyte solution. An electric current is then precisely applied, generating reactive species or directly oxidizing organic dirt, stains, and odor molecules on the fabric surface. These contaminants are electrochemically degraded into simpler, water-soluble, or volatile compounds, which are then wiped away or evaporated, minimizing water usage and avoiding harsh chemicals.

A sealed garment cabinet that uses a small, contained reservoir of water. This water is rapidly heated to generate superheated, dry steam (vapor without liquid droplets). This superheated steam is circulated through the garments, effectively sterilizing, deodorizing, and loosening superficial dirt and oils through thermal shock and vapor action. The steam then cools, condenses, and is immediately collected, filtered, and returned to the reservoir for continuous reuse, achieving powerful cleaning with extremely low water replenishment.

A garment "freshener" chamber that uses UV-C light to sanitize and deodorize clothes, especially those that are not visibly dirty but need refreshing. This significantly reduces the frequency of water-intensive washes, particularly for delicate items or outerwear.

These contaminants are then converted into volatile byproducts or easily detachable fragments that are removed by a gentle vacuum system, providing a deep, dry, and chemical-free surface cleaning and deodorization, minimizing the need for water washes.

The absorbed energy causes rapid, localized micro-vaporization or thermal decomposition of the contaminant, effectively "ablating" it from the fabric surface without heating or damaging the surrounding fibers. A gentle vacuum collects the resulting microscopic debris, providing an extremely targeted, water-free, and residue-free cleaning method.

A targeted spray or fine mist system that applies a fabric-safe mixture of biofilm-dispersing enzymes, mild natural dispersants, or lytic bacteriophages onto garments. This treatment specifically breaks down the sticky matrix of microbial biofilms and the embedded dirt/odor compounds, allowing them to be easily wiped away with a damp cloth or lifted by a gentle air current and filtration system, significantly reducing the need for bulk water washing to eliminate persistent smells and grime.

This controlled heating causes volatile odor-causing compounds, body oils, and light organic residues embedded in the fabric to desorb (vaporize) from the fibers. A continuous, gentle airflow then carries these volatilized contaminants to a filtration or catalytic oxidation unit for capture and safe breakdown, effectively refreshing and deodorizing garments without the use of water or chemicals, extending wear time between wet washes.

A sealed laundry drum lined with or containing pellets of a durable, fabric-safe solid catalyst (e.g., a noble metal or metal oxide catalyst). Clothes are tumbled in a precisely controlled, slightly humid or dry atmosphere containing a gentle oxidant (e.g., low concentration ozone or peroxide vapor). The catalyst promotes the gentle oxidation and breakdown of organic dirt, body oils, and odor molecules into simpler, volatile compounds (like CO2 and water vapor), which are then vented and filtered. This provides a dry, continuous, and chemical-free deep cleaning with no water requirement for the actual cleaning.

These enzymes, under optimized temperature and humidity conditions, specifically target and degrade stubborn organic stains (e.g., grass, wine, oil) and complex odor-causing compounds embedded in fabric. The cabinet is equipped with specific light sources (e.g., visible LED light). When illuminated, the quantum dots efficiently generate highly reactive species that break down odor molecules, volatile organic compounds, and light organic soiling directly on the fabric surface. This provides a dry, chemical-free, and water-free method for refreshing garments, potentially using lower energy light sources and offering superior catalytic efficiency compared to traditional photocatalysts like TiO2.

A controlled environment cabinet or low-humidity wash chamber that introduces a fine mist containing beneficial, fabric-safe microbes. These microbes, under optimal conditions of temperature and humidity, "consume" odor-causing compounds and light organic soiling on garments, effectively cleaning them over a gentle, longer cycle with minimal water input.

A garment "freshener" cabinet with internal surfaces coated with a TiO2 catalyst and equipped with UV-A light sources. Clothes are hung inside, and the PCO process continuously breaks down odor molecules and airborne contaminants, providing a dry, chemical-free, and water-free method for refreshing garments and extending wear.

A garment refreshing cabinet equipped with a DBD plasma generator. Clothes are exposed to the ozone and reactive oxygen/nitrogen species produced by the DBD. These species effectively break down odor molecules, volatile organic compounds, and microbial contaminants on the fabric surface without direct contact, heat, or water, providing dry sanitization and deodorization.

A garment refresh chamber where clothes are exposed to a specific low-temperature plasma (e.g., derived from oxygen or hydrogen precursor gases). This plasma generates energetic reactive species tuned to gently react with and break down organic residues (body oils, odors, superficial grime) on the fabric surface. These contaminants are converted into volatile byproducts that are then vacuumed away, providing a deep, dry clean at a molecular level without water or harsh chemicals, thereby extending garment life.

A smart wardrobe or garment cabinet that maintains a precisely controlled, low-oxygen (hypoxic) internal atmosphere. By reducing the oxygen concentration around garments, the growth and metabolic activity of odor-causing bacteria and fungi are significantly inhibited, effectively preventing the development of unpleasant smells and extending the freshness of clothes without washing or chemical deodorizers, thus reducing water usage.

Integrate a cold plasma generator into a laundry appliance or a dedicated garment cabinet. Clothes are exposed to plasma, which effectively breaks down odor-causing compounds and sanitizes the fabric, extending wear time between full washes and significantly reducing water consumption.

A targeted handheld device or a small chamber with specialized electrodes. Garments, or specific soiled areas, are exposed to a minimal film of a slightly conductive, fabric-safe electrolyte solution. An electric current is then precisely applied, generating reactive species or directly oxidizing organic dirt, stains, and odor molecules on the fabric surface. These contaminants are electrochemically degraded into simpler, water-soluble, or volatile compounds, which are then wiped away or evaporated, minimizing water usage and avoiding harsh chemicals.

A sealed garment cabinet that uses a small, contained reservoir of water. This water is rapidly heated to generate superheated, dry steam (vapor without liquid droplets). This superheated steam is circulated through the garments, effectively sterilizing, deodorizing, and loosening superficial dirt and oils through thermal shock and vapor action. The steam then cools, condenses, and is immediately collected, filtered, and returned to the reservoir for continuous reuse, achieving powerful cleaning with extremely low water replenishment.

A garment "freshener" chamber that uses UV-C light to sanitize and deodorize clothes, especially those that are not visibly dirty but need refreshing. This significantly reduces the frequency of water-intensive washes, particularly for delicate items or outerwear.

A specialized garment refresh chamber where clothes are briefly exposed to a controlled, low-energy electron beam. The electron beam's energy is tuned to target and disrupt the molecular bonds of organic dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on the fabric surface. These contaminants are then converted into volatile byproducts or easily detachable fragments that are removed by a gentle vacuum system, providing a deep, dry, and chemical-free surface cleaning and deodorization, minimizing the need for water washes.

A garment cleaning station equipped with a low-power, pulsed laser system. Optical sensors identify soiled areas, and the laser is precisely tuned (wavelength, pulse energy) to be selectively absorbed by common dirt, oils, or stain chromophores. The absorbed energy causes rapid, localized micro-vaporization or thermal decomposition of the contaminant, effectively "ablating" it from the fabric surface without heating or damaging the surrounding fibers. A gentle vacuum collects the resulting microscopic debris, providing an extremely targeted, water-free, and residue-free cleaning method.

A targeted spray or fine mist system that applies a fabric-safe mixture of biofilm-dispersing enzymes, mild natural dispersants, or lytic bacteriophages onto garments. This treatment specifically breaks down the sticky matrix of microbial biofilms and the embedded dirt/odor compounds, allowing them to be easily wiped away with a damp cloth or lifted by a gentle air current and filtration system, significantly reducing the need for bulk water washing to eliminate persistent smells and grime.

A sealed garment cabinet designed to gently heat clothes to a precisely controlled, low temperature in a dry, inert atmosphere. This controlled heating causes volatile odor-causing compounds, body oils, and light organic residues embedded in the fabric to desorb (vaporize) from the fibers. A continuous, gentle airflow then carries these volatilized contaminants to a filtration or catalytic oxidation unit for capture and safe breakdown, effectively refreshing and deodorizing garments without the use of water or chemicals, extending wear time between wet washes.

A sealed laundry drum lined with or containing pellets of a durable, fabric-safe solid catalyst (e.g., a noble metal or metal oxide catalyst). Clothes are tumbled in a precisely controlled, slightly humid or dry atmosphere containing a gentle oxidant (e.g., low concentration ozone or peroxide vapor). The catalyst promotes the gentle oxidation and breakdown of organic dirt, body oils, and odor molecules into simpler, volatile compounds (like CO2 and water vapor), which are then vented and filtered. This provides a dry, continuous, and chemical-free deep cleaning with no water requirement for the actual cleaning.

A controlled environment cabinet or low-humidity wash chamber that applies a fine, fabric-safe mist containing targeted fungal enzymes or specific fungal spore extracts. These enzymes, under optimized temperature and humidity conditions, specifically target and degrade stubborn organic stains (e.g., grass, wine, oil) and complex odor-causing compounds embedded in fabric. This breaks the stains down into smaller, water-soluble, or volatile molecules that are easily wiped away or dissipated by gentle airflow, significantly reducing the need for bulk water washing and harsh chemicals for tough stains.

included_members.abstraction: Non-reactive, low-stress processing environment: maintain a dry, inert or low-oxygen atmosphere, controlled humidity, and gentle mechanical support/handling to avoid oxidation and physical damage while desorption occurs.

included_members.description: maintain a dry, inert or low-oxygen atmosphere, controlled humidity, and gentle mechanical support/handling to avoid oxidation and physical damage while desorption occurs.
included_members.explanation: Describes a dry, controlled atmosphere to enable desorption while avoiding oxidation—fits dry decontamination/refresh approaches rather than wet washing.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed laundry drum lined with or containing pellets of a durable, fabric-safe solid catalyst (e.g., a noble metal or metal oxide catalyst). Clothes are tumbled in a precisely controlled, slightly humid or dry atmosphere containing a gentle oxidant (e.g., low concentration ozone or peroxide vapor). The catalyst promotes the gentle oxidation and breakdown of organic dirt, body oils, and odor molecules into simpler, volatile compounds (like CO2 and water vapor), which are then vented and filtered. This provides a dry, continuous, and chemical-free deep cleaning with no water requirement for the actual cleaning.

included_members.idea_text: A controlled environment cabinet or low-humidity wash chamber that applies a fine, fabric-safe mist containing targeted fungal enzymes or specific fungal spore extracts. These enzymes, under optimized temperature and humidity conditions, specifically target and degrade stubborn organic stains (e.g., grass, wine, oil) and complex odor-causing compounds embedded in fabric. This breaks the stains down into smaller, water-soluble, or volatile molecules that are easily wiped away or dissipated by gentle airflow, significantly reducing the need for bulk water washing and harsh chemicals for tough stains.
included_members.abstraction: Targeted enzymatic/biocatalytic degradation: Employ specific enzymes or biological extracts that catalytically cleave stain and odor molecules into smaller fragments that are easier to remove.
included_members.label: Targeted enzymatic/biocatalytic degradation
included_members.description: Employ specific enzymes or biological extracts that catalytically cleave stain and odor molecules into smaller fragments that are easier to remove.
included_members.explanation: Uses enzymes/biocatalysts to chemically break down stains/odors without bulk washing—dry chemical/biological decontamination.

included_members.abstraction: Sealed low-humidity reaction chamber: A contained cabinet that controls humidity, temperature, exposure time, and containment to create conditions favorable for the enzymatic reactions while limiting water use.

included_members.explanation: Controlled low-humidity chamber to enable enzymatic reactions—supports biological/chemical decontamination without liquid washing.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet with internal surfaces coated with or containing encapsulated, fabric-safe quantum dots. The cabinet is equipped with specific light sources (e.g., visible LED light). When illuminated, the quantum dots efficiently generate highly reactive species that break down odor molecules, volatile organic compounds, and light organic soiling directly on the fabric surface. This provides a dry, chemical-free, and water-free method for refreshing garments, potentially using lower energy light sources and offering superior catalytic efficiency compared to traditional photocatalysts like TiO2.
included_members.abstraction: Surface-integrated photoactive catalysts producing reactive species: Photoactive materials applied to or embedded in interior surfaces that, when illuminated, generate reactive species (e.g., ROS or equivalent) that act on contaminants on fabric surfaces.
included_members.label: Surface-integrated photoactive catalysts producing reactive species
included_members.description: Photoactive materials applied to or embedded in interior surfaces that, when illuminated, generate reactive species (e.g., ROS or equivalent) that act on contaminants on fabric surfaces.
included_members.explanation: Photoactive catalysts generate reactive species that chemically decompose contaminants without water, fitting dry chemical decontamination.

nodes.name: Field-driven manipulation/extraction (electric, magnetic, acoustic, thermal-gradient)
nodes.description: Use externally applied fields/gradients to mobilize, aggregate, or extract contaminants in low/no liquid.
idea_text: A specialized garment cleaning chamber that briefly chills clothes to cryogenic temperatures (e.g., using a controlled blast of chilled air or liquid nitrogen vapor). This causes embedded dirt, chewing gum, or stubborn stains to become brittle, allowing them to be easily dislodged and vibrated or brushed off the fabric without the need for water or solvents.

Develop a cleaning system that introduces microscopic, fabric-safe magnetic particles (e.g., in a fine mist or dry powder form) engineered to selectively adhere to dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on garments. After a brief tumbling period to ensure contact, a powerful, oscillating magnetic field is applied to pull these dirt-laden magnetic particles out of the fabric and into a collection chamber for separation and potential reuse.

A specialized washing unit where clothes are suspended in a minimal amount of slightly conductive water or a weak electrolyte solution. The chamber incorporates alternating cation and anion exchange membranes. By applying an electric current, charged dirt particles (ions) and dissolved impurities are drawn out of the fabric and across the membranes, leaving cleaner fabric and significantly purified water for near-complete reuse within the closed system.

A laundry chamber designed to expose garments to a very thin, fabric-safe, conductive liquid film (e.g., minimal water with a mild electrolyte). An oscillating electric field is applied across the fabric. Dirt and oil particles, which often carry a net electrical charge, are made to migrate through the liquid film towards specialized collector electrodes or a permeable membrane, effectively "scavenging" them off the fabric with significantly less water and no mechanical scrubbing.

A specialized enclosed chamber where garments are suspended and gently agitated by powerful, non-audible ultrasonic standing waves. This contactless "tumbling" and manipulation effectively loosens dry dirt, dust, and lint from the fabric fibers. A gentle filtered airflow simultaneously draws away the dislodged particles into a collection system, providing a dry, contact-free cleaning and refreshing process without any water or mechanical wear on the fabric.

A system where garments are briefly immersed in a minimal volume of a low-viscosity, fabric-safe MR fluid. A pulsed magnetic field is then applied, causing the fluid to momentarily thicken around the fabric fibers, effectively encapsulating and mechanically stressing embedded dirt and oil particles. When the field is removed, the fluid instantly thins, releasing the loosened dirt, which is then carried away by filtration. The fluid is continuously recycled and purified for subsequent uses with minimal loss and no water.

A minimal-water wash system where clothes are immersed in a very small volume of water containing a low concentration of cleaning agents. High-frequency acoustic transducers are precisely arrayed to generate acoustic radiation forces that gently 'push' and aggregate dirt particles within the water towards a specific collection zone or filter, without requiring bulk fluid flow or mechanical agitation of the clothes. This allows for highly efficient dirt removal from the water, enabling near-complete water recirculation and minimal fresh water input for effective cleaning.

A flat or slightly curved surface where garments are laid. A system of precise nozzles applies micro-droplets of a specialized, low-surface-tension cleaning solution to stained areas. Electrodes beneath the surface then apply electric fields to dynamically move, oscillate, or "scrub" these droplets over the fabric, dislodging dirt. The dirty droplets are then electro-wetting-guided to a collection port, allowing for extremely targeted cleaning with minuscule water usage.

A garment chamber where clothes are exposed to precisely tuned RF or microwave fields. The frequency and power are optimized to selectively heat and slightly expand/soften the dirt particles or the interface layer between dirt and fabric, without significantly heating the fabric itself. This localized thermal stress, combined with gentle mechanical tumbling or air currents, causes the dirt to lose adhesion and be dislodged. A filtration system then collects the removed particles, providing a water-free cleaning method.

A specialized cleaning plate or drum lining made of a piezoelectric material. Clothes are gently pressed against or tumbled on this surface. Interdigitated electrodes on the surface generate high-frequency SAWs that propagate along the interface with the fabric. These SAWs exert precise, localized mechanical forces on dirt particles at the fabric surface, effectively "sweeping" or "vibrating" them off without needing bulk water, solvents, or bulk ultrasonic cavitation. The dislodged dirt is collected by an integrated vacuum system.

Design fabrics or fabric liners with embedded electret properties. As clothes tumble or are gently agitated in a dry environment, the electret material actively generates electric fields that either repel charged dust and dirt particles from the fabric surface or attract them to a dedicated, removable collection component, effectively cleaning without water.

A sealed garment cabinet or tumbling drum equipped with a heating and cooling system to create a controlled temperature gradient across the fabric surface in a dry environment. As garments are gently tumbled or suspended, the temperature gradient induces thermophoretic forces that gently drive fine dust, lint, and superficial particulate dirt away from the warmer fabric surface towards a colder collection plate or filter, effectively removing dry contaminants without water.

A garment refreshing cabinet where an internal electric field generates a controlled "ion wind" or electrohydrodynamic flow. This silent, gentle, localized air current is directed across the fabric surfaces, physically dislodging dry dust, lint, and carrying away odor molecules without any moving mechanical parts. The dislodged particles and odors are then collected by an integrated filter and purification system, providing a water-free and gentle cleaning method.

A specialized laundry drum or cabinet with embedded micro-electrodes near the fabric surface. When clothes are present, a precisely controlled, short, high-energy electrical pulse is applied. This generates localized, micro-scale mechanical shockwaves within the fabric itself or at the fabric-dirt interface, effectively breaking the adhesive bonds of embedded dirt and grime without damaging the fibers. The dislodged particles are then removed by a gentle vacuum and filtration system, providing a water-free cleaning method that targets deeply embedded contaminants.

Design a laundry drum that tumbles clothes in a low-humidity environment, inducing an electrostatic charge on both fabric and dirt particles. The charged dirt particles are then attracted to an oppositely charged collector plate or filter within the drum, effectively "lifting" them off the fabric without water.

A minimal-water washing chamber where clothes are briefly exposed to a mild, fabric-safe aqueous solution. Pulsed electric fields are then applied across the solution and fabric. These pulses disrupt the integrity of microbial biofilms (which encase much of the dirt and odor-causing bacteria) and weaken the electrostatic or cohesive bonds of embedded dirt particles, making them easier to detach and rinse away with significantly less water and agitation.

A specialized laundry chamber or drum where clothes are immersed in a very minimal volume of water with a mild electrolyte. An electric potential is applied across the fabric. This induces electro-osmotic flow, drawing dirty water (and dissolved/suspended contaminants) directly out of the fabric pores towards a collection electrode or permeable membrane, effectively "flushing" the fabric internally with minimal bulk water movement or mechanical agitation. The collected dirty water is then processed for disposal or further purification.

A highly specialized garment cleaning station equipped with a low-energy, broad, non-damaging ion beam. Optical sensors identify and map individual dirt particles or stains. The ion beam is then directed to these specific micro-regions, where the kinetic energy of the ions physically dislodges and sputters away the contaminant molecules from the fabric surface without damaging the fibers. A gentle vacuum system collects the sputtered debris, providing an ultra-precise, water-free, and residue-free spot cleaning method.

A dry or minimal-mist garment cleaning system that introduces a fine, fabric-safe ferrofluid mist onto clothes. This ferrofluid is engineered to preferentially bind to or encapsulate dirt and oil particles. After a brief dwell time, a localized, oscillating magnetic field is applied. This causes the dirt-laden ferrofluid to be agitated, moved, and then drawn out of the fabric by the magnetic field onto a collection surface, or into a separation chamber, effectively extracting dirt without bulk water. The ferrofluid can then be regenerated and reused.

Garments are manufactured with embedded or surface-applied microscopic, optically responsive elements (e.g., plasmonic nanoparticles or specialized polymer fibers). When placed in a dry cleaning chamber and illuminated with precisely tuned, non-damaging light wavelengths, these elements preferentially absorb energy. This causes rapid, localized micro-thermal expansion and contraction or phase change directly at the fabric-dirt interface, physically agitating and dislodging dirt particles. A gentle airflow then removes the loosened particles, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method leveraging engineered fabric properties.

A sealed garment cabinet that generates a fine, electrostatically charged mist of ultra-pure water (or a mild cleaning solution). These charged nano-droplets are engineered to act as "dirt nuclei," preferentially attracting and encapsulating fine particulate dirt, lint, and odor molecules from the garments via electrostatic forces and targeted surface chemistry. Once sufficiently agglomerated and weighted with contaminants, a controlled electrostatic field or gentle air current causes these dirt-laden droplets to coalesce and precipitate onto a collection surface at the bottom of the chamber, effectively "raining" the dirt out of the fabric without wetting the garment or requiring mechanical action.

included_members.idea_text: Garments are manufactured with embedded or surface-applied microscopic, optically responsive elements (e.g., plasmonic nanoparticles or specialized polymer fibers). When placed in a dry cleaning chamber and illuminated with precisely tuned, non-damaging light wavelengths, these elements preferentially absorb energy. This causes rapid, localized micro-thermal expansion and contraction or phase change directly at the fabric-dirt interface, physically agitating and dislodging dirt particles. A gentle airflow then removes the loosened particles, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method leveraging engineered fabric properties.
included_members.abstraction: Optically induced localized micro-thermal/mechanical agitation: Use light at tuned wavelengths to excite embedded/surface-responsive elements so they locally heat, expand/contract, or change phase at the fabric–dirt interface, producing micro-scale agitation that dislodges contaminants.
included_members.label: Optically induced localized micro-thermal/mechanical agitation
included_members.description: Use light at tuned wavelengths to excite embedded/surface-responsive elements so they locally heat, expand/contract, or change phase at the fabric–dirt interface, producing micro-scale agitation that dislodges contaminants.
included_members.explanation: Applies externally delivered optical energy to create localized thermal/mechanical effects at the soil interface—field/energy-driven manipulation.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet that generates a fine, electrostatically charged mist of ultra-pure water (or a mild cleaning solution). These charged nano-droplets are engineered to act as "dirt nuclei," preferentially attracting and encapsulating fine particulate dirt, lint, and odor molecules from the garments via electrostatic forces and targeted surface chemistry. Once sufficiently agglomerated and weighted with contaminants, a controlled electrostatic field or gentle air current causes these dirt-laden droplets to coalesce and precipitate onto a collection surface at the bottom of the chamber, effectively "raining" the dirt out of the fabric without wetting the garment or requiring mechanical action.

nodes.name: Transfer-to-removable carrier (films, sheets, particles, adsorptive media)
nodes.description: Bind soils to an intermediate removable medium (solid/gel/particles/sheets) and remove/regenerate it.
idea_text: A targeted spray or applicator pen that dispenses a concentrated blend of fabric-safe enzymes onto specific stains. After a short dwell time, the broken-down stain components can be wiped away with a damp cloth or absorbed by a dry, absorbent pad, eliminating the need for a full water wash for localized soiling.

A sealed garment cabinet where clothes are hung. The cabinet incorporates a fan that circulates air through the garments and then through a bed of adsorptive material (e.g., activated carbon filters or zeolite beads). This system passively removes odors and fine dust particles from clothing, extending wear time between washes without using any water.

A specialized tumbling drum system where clothes are cleaned with a mixture of tiny, reusable cryogel granules. These granules gently abrade the fabric, absorbing oils, dirt, and odor molecules. After the cycle, the granules are separated from the clothes, cleaned (e.g., by vacuuming or solvent bath), and reused, with no water used in the garment cleaning process itself.

Disposable or reusable "wicking sheets" impregnated with a small amount of cleaning agent that are placed inside or alongside garments in a low-humidity tumbling drum or dedicated cabinet. These sheets actively draw moisture, body oils, and dissolved grime out of the garment fibers through capillary action, trapping them within the sheet and refreshing the clothing with minimal to no external water.

Develop a cleaning system that introduces microscopic, fabric-safe magnetic particles (e.g., in a fine mist or dry powder form) engineered to selectively adhere to dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on garments. After a brief tumbling period to ensure contact, a powerful, oscillating magnetic field is applied to pull these dirt-laden magnetic particles out of the fabric and into a collection chamber for separation and potential reuse.

A low-water garment cleaning system utilizing a highly concentrated, non-toxic cleaning solution or a solid osmotic agent. Garments are placed in contact with this agent or solution, and due to the osmotic pressure difference, water (containing dissolved dirt and body oils from the fabric fibers) is drawn out of the fabric and into the concentrated medium, effectively cleaning the garment with minimal external water.

A sealed garment cabinet containing regenerable desiccant materials (e.g., advanced zeolites or MOFs) and a fan. Air is circulated through the garments and then over the desiccant bed. The desiccant actively pulls moisture (and dissolved body oils/odors) directly from the fabric into the air stream, and then adsorbs it. This dry extraction process cleanses and deodorizes garments without the use of water. The desiccant can then be heated to release the dirty moisture for disposal and regenerate for reuse.

A specialized, highly reusable sheet or pad made from a superhydrophilic, finely textured material designed to be placed in a tumbling dryer or a dedicated refresh cabinet with clothes. During a brief cycle with a very fine, minimal mist of water, this sheet actively attracts and captures body oils, dissolved dirt, and fine particulate matter released from the garments. The superhydrophilic material "wicks" and holds these contaminants, effectively cleaning the clothes with minimal water, and the sheet is then rinsed clean for reuse.

A controlled chamber system that applies a fine, non-toxic, biodegradable, and fabric-safe "bio-slime" (e.g., a hydrogel-based polymer with specific adhesive properties) mist onto clothes. This slime is engineered to be slightly adhesive to dirt and odor molecules. After a short dwell time, a second stage triggers a controlled 'shedding' or breakdown of the slime (e.g., via a pH change or mild vibration), causing it to detach from the fabric, carrying the trapped dirt and odors with it, into a collection system. The slime is then processed for disposal or regeneration, leaving clean, residue-free clothes with minimal water usage.

A garment refreshing cabinet that utilizes a bed of regenerable, fabric-safe chemical sorbents (e.g., modified amines or Metal-Organic Frameworks). These sorbents are specifically engineered to reversibly bind volatile organic compounds (VOCs) responsible for odors. Air is circulated through the garments and then over the sorbent bed, trapping odors. The sorbent is then periodically regenerated (e.g., by heating or pressure swing), releasing concentrated odors for safe disposal, making this a highly efficient, water-free, and chemical-free deodorization system.

A garment cleaning system where a very fine, dry, and biodegradable micro-abrasive powder (e.g., cellulose beads) is gently dusted onto clothes. A precisely controlled, low-power pulsed laser beam then scans the fabric. The laser energy interacts with the micro-abrasive particles, causing them to gently 'lift' or 'etch' away dirt and grime from the fabric surface through localized photomechanical action. The dirty micro-abrasive is then vacuumed away, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.

A laundry appliance featuring a series of rotating polymer rollers whose surfaces are engineered to have a higher affinity for common dirt and oil molecules than for fabric fibers. As garments pass through, these rollers gently contact the fabric, transferring dirt and oils from the clothes onto their own surfaces. A secondary, integrated mechanism continuously cleans the rollers (e.g., with a scraper or micro-solvent spray which is then recovered), enabling continuous dirt removal from clothes without water.

Garments are treated with a dissolvable or detachable nanocoating that has a stronger affinity for dirt/oils than for fabric fibers. After wear, the garments are placed in a gentle tumbling drum or cabinet. A mild, fabric-safe trigger (e.g., a specific light wavelength, a slight humidity change, or a very mild vibration) causes the nanocoating to rapidly delaminate or de-bond from the fabric, encapsulating and releasing the accumulated dirt. The shed nanocoating and dirt particles are then collected by a vacuum and filter system, leaving clean fabric with no water.

A system that applies a fine mist containing microscopic, biodegradable, decellularized bio-scaffold particles onto clothes. These particles are engineered to have a high affinity for common organic dirt and odors. After a short dwell time in a low-humidity environment, a mild trigger (e.g., specific light, very gentle vibration) initiates the controlled degradation or detachment of the bio-scaffold, taking the encapsulated dirt and odor molecules with it into a collection system, leaving clean garments with minimal water usage.

A dry-cleaning appliance featuring rollers made from a "smart" polymer whose surface energy can be tuned. As garments pass through, a mild stimulus (e.g., a specific light wavelength) temporarily increases the roller's adhesion, causing it to pick up dirt and oils from the fabric. A different stimulus then reduces the adhesion, causing the collected dirt to release from the roller into a waste receptacle, making the roller self-cleaning and reusable for continuous water-free garment cleaning.

A low-water garment cleaning chamber where clothes are immersed in a minimal volume of specialized, mildly aqueous solution. Fine, microscopic air bubbles are then introduced into the solution. These bubbles are engineered to selectively adhere to hydrophobic dirt, oils, and grease particles embedded in the fabric. The dirt-laden bubbles rise to the surface, forming a stable "froth" that is continuously skimmed off and filtered, effectively extracting contaminants from the garments with extremely low water usage and minimal mechanical agitation. The cleaned water is then recirculated.

A laundry system where a fine, fabric-safe, dissolvable or semi-solid film-forming polymer solution is applied to the garment as a mist or thin coating. This film is engineered with adsorptive properties for dirt, oils, and odors. After a short drying/curing time in a low-humidity environment, the film solidifies, encapsulating the contaminants. It is then gently peeled off the garment by hand or an automated roller, carrying the accumulated dirt away, leaving clean fabric without water rinsing.
