included_members.description: A sealed enclosure circulates air across hung garments and through sorbent/filtration media so contaminants are captured from the air/fabric; a fan or similar mover drives the airflow and the enclosure concentrates treatment.
included_members.explanation: Captures contaminants using sorbent/filtration media (removable adsorptive carriers) in a closed air loop.

included_members.idea_text: A specialized tumbling drum system where clothes are cleaned with a mixture of tiny, reusable cryogel granules. These granules gently abrade the fabric, absorbing oils, dirt, and odor molecules. After the cycle, the granules are separated from the clothes, cleaned (e.g., by vacuuming or solvent bath), and reused, with no water used in the garment cleaning process itself.
included_members.abstraction: Reusable particulate adsorptive/abrasive medium: A solid granular medium that both adsorbs/absorbs contaminants and provides mild abrasive contact to lift soils from fabric surfaces; designed for repeated use.
included_members.label: Reusable particulate adsorptive/abrasive medium
included_members.description: A solid granular medium that both adsorbs/absorbs contaminants and provides mild abrasive contact to lift soils from fabric surfaces; designed for repeated use.
included_members.explanation: Transfers soils to a reusable solid granular medium that can be removed/regenerated.

included_members.idea_text: A specialized tumbling drum system where clothes are cleaned with a mixture of tiny, reusable cryogel granules. These granules gently abrade the fabric, absorbing oils, dirt, and odor molecules. After the cycle, the granules are separated from the clothes, cleaned (e.g., by vacuuming or solvent bath), and reused, with no water used in the garment cleaning process itself.
included_members.abstraction: Tumbling/agitation contact mechanism: A rotating or agitating vessel that mixes textiles with the particulate medium to create repeated contact events and relative motion necessary for soil transfer.
included_members.label: Tumbling/agitation contact mechanism
included_members.description: A rotating or agitating vessel that mixes textiles with the particulate medium to create repeated contact events and relative motion necessary for soil transfer.
included_members.explanation: Tumbling/agitation is the contact mechanism enabling soil transfer onto the removable particulate carrier.

included_members.idea_text: A specialized tumbling drum system where clothes are cleaned with a mixture of tiny, reusable cryogel granules. These granules gently abrade the fabric, absorbing oils, dirt, and odor molecules. After the cycle, the granules are separated from the clothes, cleaned (e.g., by vacuuming or solvent bath), and reused, with no water used in the garment cleaning process itself.
included_members.abstraction: Separation and regeneration processes: Processes and equipment to separate the particulate medium from textiles, remove collected soils from the medium, and restore its cleaning function for reuse.
included_members.label: Separation and regeneration processes
included_members.description: Processes and equipment to separate the particulate medium from textiles, remove collected soils from the medium, and restore its cleaning function for reuse.
included_members.explanation: Separation/regeneration describes the lifecycle of the solid carrier that collects contaminants.

included_members.idea_text: A specialized tumbling drum system where clothes are cleaned with a mixture of tiny, reusable cryogel granules. These granules gently abrade the fabric, absorbing oils, dirt, and odor molecules. After the cycle, the granules are separated from the clothes, cleaned (e.g., by vacuuming or solvent bath), and reused, with no water used in the garment cleaning process itself.
included_members.abstraction: Gentle selective cleaning action: Material and mechanical properties tuned to preferentially take up oils/odors and dislodge particulate dirt without abrading or deforming fibers.
included_members.label: Gentle selective cleaning action
included_members.description: Material and mechanical properties tuned to preferentially take up oils/odors and dislodge particulate dirt without abrading or deforming fibers.
included_members.explanation: Selective uptake of oils/odors and dirt via solid medium aligns with transfer to an adsorptive carrier.

included_members.idea_text: Disposable or reusable "wicking sheets" impregnated with a small amount of cleaning agent that are placed inside or alongside garments in a low-humidity tumbling drum or dedicated cabinet. These sheets actively draw moisture, body oils, and dissolved grime out of the garment fibers through capillary action, trapping them within the sheet and refreshing the clothing with minimal to no external water.
included_members.abstraction: Capillary-driven absorption and sequestration (wicking sheet): A porous, hydrophilic absorbent layer that uses capillary action and sorption to draw out moisture, dissolved soils, and oils from textile fibers and trap them within the sheet structure.
included_members.label: Capillary-driven absorption and sequestration (wicking sheet)
included_members.description: A porous, hydrophilic absorbent layer that uses capillary action and sorption to draw out moisture, dissolved soils, and oils from textile fibers and trap them within the sheet structure.
included_members.explanation: Uses a sacrificial wicking sheet to pull and sequester soils—transfer to a removable carrier.

included_members.idea_text: Disposable or reusable "wicking sheets" impregnated with a small amount of cleaning agent that are placed inside or alongside garments in a low-humidity tumbling drum or dedicated cabinet. These sheets actively draw moisture, body oils, and dissolved grime out of the garment fibers through capillary action, trapping them within the sheet and refreshing the clothing with minimal to no external water.
included_members.abstraction: Controlled low-humidity / mechanical agitation environment: A tumbling or enclosure environment that reduces ambient humidity and/or applies gentle motion or heat to promote evaporation and drive liquid-phase contaminants toward the absorbent medium via gradients and contact.
included_members.label: Controlled low-humidity / mechanical agitation environment
included_members.description: A tumbling or enclosure environment that reduces ambient humidity and/or applies gentle motion or heat to promote evaporation and drive liquid-phase contaminants toward the absorbent medium via gradients and contact.
included_members.explanation: Humidity/heat/agitation are used to drive contaminants into the absorbent capture medium.

included_members.idea_text: Disposable or reusable "wicking sheets" impregnated with a small amount of cleaning agent that are placed inside or alongside garments in a low-humidity tumbling drum or dedicated cabinet. These sheets actively draw moisture, body oils, and dissolved grime out of the garment fibers through capillary action, trapping them within the sheet and refreshing the clothing with minimal to no external water.
included_members.abstraction: Impregnated, dose-limited cleaning chemistry in a capture matrix: Chemicals (surfactants, enzymes, solvents, or combinations) embedded or coated on the absorbent medium that solubilize or mobilize soils locally and are delivered in minimal, controlled quantities to avoid bulk water use.
included_members.label: Impregnated, dose-limited cleaning chemistry in a capture matrix
included_members.description: Chemicals (surfactants, enzymes, solvents, or combinations) embedded or coated on the absorbent medium that solubilize or mobilize soils locally and are delivered in minimal, controlled quantities to avoid bulk water use.
included_members.explanation: Cleaning chemistry embedded in an absorbent matrix is still a contaminant-transfer-to-carrier mechanism.

included_members.idea_text: Develop a cleaning system that introduces microscopic, fabric-safe magnetic particles (e.g., in a fine mist or dry powder form) engineered to selectively adhere to dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on garments. After a brief tumbling period to ensure contact, a powerful, oscillating magnetic field is applied to pull these dirt-laden magnetic particles out of the fabric and into a collection chamber for separation and potential reuse.
included_members.abstraction: Functionalized magnetic particulate carriers that bind contaminants: Micro- or nano-scale particles engineered with surface chemistry to selectively adhere to soils, oils, and odor molecules and that are responsive to magnetic manipulation.
included_members.label: Functionalized magnetic particulate carriers that bind contaminants
included_members.description: Micro- or nano-scale particles engineered with surface chemistry to selectively adhere to soils, oils, and odor molecules and that are responsive to magnetic manipulation.
included_members.explanation: Magnetic particles bind soils/odors, functioning as an intermediate removable carrier.

included_members.idea_text: Develop a cleaning system that introduces microscopic, fabric-safe magnetic particles (e.g., in a fine mist or dry powder form) engineered to selectively adhere to dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on garments. After a brief tumbling period to ensure contact, a powerful, oscillating magnetic field is applied to pull these dirt-laden magnetic particles out of the fabric and into a collection chamber for separation and potential reuse.
included_members.abstraction: Mechanical agitation to promote pickup: Introduce motion (e.g., tumbling, vibration) to maximize collisions and adherence events between carriers and textile-bound contaminants.
included_members.label: Mechanical agitation to promote pickup
included_members.description: Introduce motion (e.g., tumbling, vibration) to maximize collisions and adherence events between carriers and textile-bound contaminants.
included_members.explanation: Agitation increases contact so contaminants transfer onto the carrier particles.

included_members.idea_text: Develop a cleaning system that introduces microscopic, fabric-safe magnetic particles (e.g., in a fine mist or dry powder form) engineered to selectively adhere to dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on garments. After a brief tumbling period to ensure contact, a powerful, oscillating magnetic field is applied to pull these dirt-laden magnetic particles out of the fabric and into a collection chamber for separation and potential reuse.
included_members.abstraction: Particle collection and regeneration subsystem: Systems and processes that separate collected carrier+contaminant from the machine, clean or process them, and prepare carriers for reuse.
included_members.label: Particle collection and regeneration subsystem
included_members.description: Systems and processes that separate collected carrier+contaminant from the machine, clean or process them, and prepare carriers for reuse.
included_members.explanation: Collection/regeneration focuses on recovering and reusing the removable carrier medium.

included_members.idea_text: A low-water garment cleaning system utilizing a highly concentrated, non-toxic cleaning solution or a solid osmotic agent. Garments are placed in contact with this agent or solution, and due to the osmotic pressure difference, water (containing dissolved dirt and body oils from the fabric fibers) is drawn out of the fabric and into the concentrated medium, effectively cleaning the garment with minimal external water.
included_members.abstraction: Osmotic-pressure-driven extraction of water and solutes from fabric: A concentrated medium placed in contact with the garment creates an osmotic (or chemical-potential) differential that draws water containing dissolved soils and oils out of fibers into the medium; this mass-transfer is the functional core of the idea.
included_members.label: Osmotic-pressure-driven extraction of water and solutes from fabric
included_members.description: A concentrated medium placed in contact with the garment creates an osmotic (or chemical-potential) differential that draws water containing dissolved soils and oils out of fibers into the medium; this mass-transfer is the functional core of the idea.
included_members.explanation: Uses an osmotic gradient to pull water/solutes out of fabric into a concentrated medium—contaminant transfer to a carrier/sink.

included_members.idea_text: A low-water garment cleaning system utilizing a highly concentrated, non-toxic cleaning solution or a solid osmotic agent. Garments are placed in contact with this agent or solution, and due to the osmotic pressure difference, water (containing dissolved dirt and body oils from the fabric fibers) is drawn out of the fabric and into the concentrated medium, effectively cleaning the garment with minimal external water.
included_members.abstraction: Water-sequestering absorbent medium that captures extracted fluid: Materials or structures that take up and retain the removed water and dissolved contaminants, preventing re-deposition and enabling low net external water use.
included_members.label: Water-sequestering absorbent medium that captures extracted fluid
included_members.description: Materials or structures that take up and retain the removed water and dissolved contaminants, preventing re-deposition and enabling low net external water use.
included_members.explanation: Absorbent/sequestering medium captures extracted fluid and soils—binding to a removable/containable carrier.

included_members.idea_text: A low-water garment cleaning system utilizing a highly concentrated, non-toxic cleaning solution or a solid osmotic agent. Garments are placed in contact with this agent or solution, and due to the osmotic pressure difference, water (containing dissolved dirt and body oils from the fabric fibers) is drawn out of the fabric and into the concentrated medium, effectively cleaning the garment with minimal external water.
included_members.abstraction: Contact-mediated containment and transfer mechanism: Physical arrangement and interfaces (sheets, pouches, wraps, pressure contact) that ensure intimate contact between fabric and the concentrated medium and enable transfer while containing the medium and soils.
included_members.label: Contact-mediated containment and transfer mechanism
included_members.description: Physical arrangement and interfaces (sheets, pouches, wraps, pressure contact) that ensure intimate contact between fabric and the concentrated medium and enable transfer while containing the medium and soils.
included_members.explanation: Sheets/pouches/wraps enable contact transfer of soils into the medium—carrier-mediated removal.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet containing regenerable desiccant materials (e.g., advanced zeolites or MOFs) and a fan. Air is circulated through the garments and then over the desiccant bed. The desiccant actively pulls moisture (and dissolved body oils/odors) directly from the fabric into the air stream, and then adsorbs it. This dry extraction process cleanses and deodorizes garments without the use of water. The desiccant can then be heated to release the dirty moisture for disposal and regenerate for reuse.
included_members.abstraction: Adsorptive extraction of water and volatiles from fabrics: Core functional process: draw moisture and dissolved organic compounds out of textile fibers into an air stream and bind them onto a solid sorbent material.
included_members.label: Adsorptive extraction of water and volatiles from fabrics
included_members.description: Core functional process: draw moisture and dissolved organic compounds out of textile fibers into an air stream and bind them onto a solid sorbent material.
included_members.explanation: Transfers moisture/volatiles from fabric into air then binds them onto a solid sorbent—removal via a capture medium.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet containing regenerable desiccant materials (e.g., advanced zeolites or MOFs) and a fan. The desiccant actively pulls moisture (and dissolved body oils/odors) directly from the fabric into the air stream, and then adsorbs it. included_members.abstraction: Air circulation across garments and sorbent: Establish directed airflow that contacts textiles to entrain moisture/odors and then passes that air over the sorbent for capture.
included_members.label: Air circulation across garments and sorbent
included_members.description: Establish directed airflow that contacts textiles to entrain moisture/odors and then passes that air over the sorbent for capture.
included_members.explanation: Uses airflow to move contaminants to a sorbent carrier, i.e., transfer-to-removable adsorptive media.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet containing regenerable desiccant materials (e.g., advanced zeolites or MOFs) and a fan. Air is circulated through the garments and then over the desiccant bed. The desiccant actively pulls moisture (and dissolved body oils/odors) directly from the fabric into the air stream, and then adsorbs it. This dry extraction process cleanses and deodorizes garments without the use of water. The desiccant can then be heated to release the dirty moisture for disposal and regenerate for reuse.
included_members.abstraction: Thermal or pressure‑driven sorbent regeneration and waste removal: Release captured moisture/contaminants from the sorbent by applying heat or a pressure/flow change, then remove or condense the released material and restore sorbent capacity.
included_members.label: Thermal or pressure‑driven sorbent regeneration and waste removal
included_members.description: Release captured moisture/contaminants from the sorbent by applying heat or a pressure/flow change, then remove or condense the released material and restore sorbent capacity.
included_members.explanation: Regenerates the sorbent capture medium, consistent with a removable/regenerable carrier approach.

included_members.idea_text: A specialized, highly reusable sheet or pad made from a superhydrophilic, finely textured material designed to be placed in a tumbling dryer or a dedicated refresh cabinet with clothes. During a brief cycle with a very fine, minimal mist of water, this sheet actively attracts and captures body oils, dissolved dirt, and fine particulate matter released from the garments. The superhydrophilic material "wicks" and holds these contaminants, effectively cleaning the clothes with minimal water, and the sheet is then rinsed clean for reuse.
included_members.abstraction: Superhydrophilic wicking capture medium: A material interface that preferentially draws in water and dissolved/particulate contaminants from nearby textiles and retains them via capillary/adsorptive mechanisms.
included_members.label: Superhydrophilic wicking capture medium
included_members.description: A material interface that preferentially draws in water and dissolved/particulate contaminants from nearby textiles and retains them via capillary/adsorptive mechanisms.
included_members.explanation: A wicking/adsorptive interface pulls contaminants into a removable capture medium (transfer to carrier).

included_members.idea_text: A specialized, highly reusable sheet or pad made from a superhydrophilic, finely textured material designed to be placed in a tumbling dryer or a dedicated refresh cabinet with clothes. During a brief cycle with a very fine, minimal mist of water, this sheet actively attracts and captures body oils, dissolved dirt, and fine particulate matter released from the garments. The superhydrophilic material "wicks" and holds these contaminants, effectively cleaning the clothes with minimal water, and the sheet is then rinsed clean for reuse.
included_members.abstraction: Mechanical contact-driven transfer: Agitation, tumbling, or airflow that brings textile surfaces into repeated contact with the capture medium to encourage transfer of loosened contaminants.
included_members.label: Mechanical contact-driven transfer
included_members.description: Agitation, tumbling, or airflow that brings textile surfaces into repeated contact with the capture medium to encourage transfer of loosened contaminants.
included_members.explanation: Agitation/contact is used primarily to promote transfer of contaminants onto the capture medium (carrier-based removal).

included_members.idea_text: A specialized, highly reusable sheet or pad made from a superhydrophilic, finely textured material designed to be placed in a tumbling dryer or a dedicated refresh cabinet with clothes. During a brief cycle with a very fine, minimal mist of water, this sheet actively attracts and captures body oils, dissolved dirt, and fine particulate matter released from the garments. The superhydrophilic material "wicks" and holds these contaminants, effectively cleaning the clothes with minimal water, and the sheet is then rinsed clean for reuse.
included_members.abstraction: Regeneration and reuse of the capture medium: A process for removing accumulated contaminants from the medium so it can be returned to service, preserving the low-water, low-material footprint.
included_members.label: Regeneration and reuse of the capture medium
included_members.description: A process for removing accumulated contaminants from the medium so it can be returned to service, preserving the low-water, low-material footprint.
included_members.explanation: Covers regeneration/reuse of the contaminant-capturing medium (removable carrier lifecycle).

included_members.idea_text: A controlled chamber system that applies a fine, non-toxic, biodegradable, and fabric-safe "bio-slime" (e.g., a hydrogel-based polymer with specific adhesive properties) mist onto clothes. This slime is engineered to be slightly adhesive to dirt and odor molecules. After a short dwell time, a second stage triggers a controlled 'shedding' or breakdown of the slime (e.g., via a pH change or mild vibration), causing it to detach from the fabric, carrying the trapped dirt and odors with it, into a collection system. The slime is then processed for disposal or regeneration, leaving clean, residue-free clothes with minimal water usage.
included_members.abstraction: Temporary adhesive capture medium applied to fabric: Introduce a transient, fabric-safe medium with selective affinity for dirt/odor molecules that can be applied uniformly to textiles and hold contaminants without leaving residue.
included_members.label: Temporary adhesive capture medium applied to fabric
included_members.description: Introduce a transient, fabric-safe medium with selective affinity for dirt/odor molecules that can be applied uniformly to textiles and hold contaminants without leaving residue.
included_members.explanation: Applies a temporary adhesive phase that binds contaminants and is later removed—classic transfer to removable carrier.

included_members.idea_text: A controlled chamber system that applies a fine, non-toxic, biodegradable, and fabric-safe "bio-slime" (e.g., a hydrogel-based polymer with specific adhesive properties) mist onto clothes. This slime is engineered to be slightly adhesive to dirt and odor molecules. After a short dwell time, a second stage triggers a controlled 'shedding' or breakdown of the slime (e.g., via a pH change or mild vibration), causing it to detach from the fabric, carrying the trapped dirt and odors with it, into a collection system. included_members.abstraction: Triggered destabilization to shed the medium: A mechanism to alter the medium's state or its adhesion to fibers (e.g., change in chemistry or mechanical agitation) in a controlled manner so the medium releases from the textile intact carrying contaminants.
included_members.label: Triggered destabilization to shed the medium
included_members.description: A mechanism to alter the medium's state or its adhesion to fibers (e.g., change in chemistry or mechanical agitation) in a controlled manner so the medium releases from the textile intact carrying contaminants.
included_members.explanation: Triggered release/detachment of the applied medium so it can be removed intact with captured soils.

included_members.idea_text: A controlled chamber system that applies a fine, non-toxic, biodegradable, and fabric-safe "bio-slime" (e.g., a hydrogel-based polymer with specific adhesive properties) mist onto clothes. This slime is engineered to be slightly adhesive to dirt and odor molecules. After a short dwell time, a second stage triggers a controlled 'shedding' or breakdown of the slime (e.g., via a pH change or mild vibration), causing it to detach from the fabric, carrying the trapped dirt and odors with it, into a collection system. included_members.abstraction: Containment and processing of removed medium: Systems and processes that capture the detached medium and treat, regenerate, or dispose of it with low water use and minimal environmental impact, enabling reuse or safe waste handling.
included_members.label: Containment and processing of removed medium
included_members.description: Systems and processes that capture the detached medium and treat, regenerate, or dispose of it with low water use and minimal environmental impact, enabling reuse or safe waste handling.
included_members.explanation: Concerns capturing and processing/regenerating the removed contaminant-bearing medium (carrier handling).

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet that utilizes a bed of regenerable, fabric-safe chemical sorbents (e.g., modified amines or Metal-Organic Frameworks). These sorbents are specifically engineered to reversibly bind volatile organic compounds (VOCs) responsible for odors. Air is circulated through the garments and then over the sorbent bed, trapping odors. The sorbent is then periodically regenerated (e.g., by heating or pressure swing), releasing concentrated odors for safe disposal, making this a highly efficient, water-free, and chemical-free deodorization system.
included_members.abstraction: Regenerable sorbent bed that selectively adsorbs VOCs: A solid-phase capture medium engineered to reversibly bind odor-causing volatile organic compounds with high capacity and selectivity; the primary locus where contaminants are removed from the air stream.
included_members.label: Regenerable sorbent bed that selectively adsorbs VOCs
included_members.description: A solid-phase capture medium engineered to reversibly bind odor-causing volatile organic compounds with high capacity and selectivity; the primary locus where contaminants are removed from the air stream.
included_members.explanation: A solid sorbent bed captures VOCs—contaminants are transferred to a removable/regenerable carrier.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet that utilizes a bed of regenerable, fabric-safe chemical sorbents (e.g., modified amines or Metal-Organic Frameworks). included_members.abstraction: Air circulation and routing system: Mechanisms to circulate ambient or recirculated air through garments and then through the sorbent bed to transfer volatile contaminants from textiles to the capture medium.
included_members.label: Air circulation and routing system
included_members.description: Mechanisms to circulate ambient or recirculated air through garments and then through the sorbent bed to transfer volatile contaminants from textiles to the capture medium.
included_members.explanation: Air routing moves odors from textiles to the sorbent carrier for capture.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet that utilizes a bed of regenerable, fabric-safe chemical sorbents (e.g., modified amines or Metal-Organic Frameworks). included_members.abstraction: Regeneration subsystem (thermal/pressure swing): A controlled process to desorb and concentrate captured volatiles from the sorbent, restoring capture capacity and producing a manageable waste stream for disposal or further treatment.
included_members.label: Regeneration subsystem (thermal/pressure swing)
included_members.description: A controlled process to desorb and concentrate captured volatiles from the sorbent, restoring capture capacity and producing a manageable waste stream for disposal or further treatment.
included_members.explanation: Thermal/pressure-swing regeneration restores the sorbent (the removable carrier) by desorbing captured VOCs.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet that utilizes a bed of regenerable, fabric-safe chemical sorbents (e.g., modified amines or Metal-Organic Frameworks). included_members.abstraction: Fabric-safe process constraints: Operational and material constraints ensuring the treatment does not damage textiles (e.g., limits on temperature, chemical reactivity, mechanical agitation).
included_members.label: Fabric-safe process constraints
included_members.description: Operational and material constraints ensuring the treatment does not damage textiles (e.g., limits on temperature, chemical reactivity, mechanical agitation).
included_members.explanation: Process constraints are described in service of the sorbent-based odor-transfer system (carrier-based removal).

included_members.idea_text: A garment cleaning system where a very fine, dry, and biodegradable micro-abrasive powder (e.g., cellulose beads) is gently dusted onto clothes. A precisely controlled, low-power pulsed laser beam then scans the fabric. The laser energy interacts with the micro-abrasive particles, causing them to gently 'lift' or 'etch' away dirt and grime from the fabric surface through localized photomechanical action. The dirty micro-abrasive is then vacuumed away, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.
included_members.abstraction: Dry, biodegradable micro-abrasive agent application: Applying fine, removable particles that act as transient abrasives or carriers for soil, designed to be benign and separable after use.
included_members.label: Dry, biodegradable micro-abrasive agent application
included_members.description: Applying fine, removable particles that act as transient abrasives or carriers for soil, designed to be benign and separable after use.
included_members.explanation: Applies removable micro-particles that engage soil and can be separated afterward as a carrier medium.

included_members.idea_text: A laundry appliance featuring a series of rotating polymer rollers whose surfaces are engineered to have a higher affinity for common dirt and oil molecules than for fabric fibers. As garments pass through, these rollers gently contact the fabric, transferring dirt and oils from the clothes onto their own surfaces. A secondary, integrated mechanism continuously cleans the rollers (e.g., with a scraper or micro-solvent spray which is then recovered), enabling continuous dirt removal from clothes without water.
included_members.abstraction: Selective, high-affinity contact surfaces: Surfaces engineered (chemically and/or physically) to preferentially attract and hold common dirt/oil molecules more strongly than fabric fibers, enabling directional transfer of contaminants.
included_members.label: Selective, high-affinity contact surfaces
included_members.description: Surfaces engineered (chemically and/or physically) to preferentially attract and hold common dirt/oil molecules more strongly than fabric fibers, enabling directional transfer of contaminants.
included_members.explanation: Moves contaminants directionally onto a separate high-affinity surface (removable/receiving carrier).

included_members.idea_text: A laundry appliance featuring a series of rotating polymer rollers whose surfaces are engineered to have a higher affinity for common dirt and oil molecules than for fabric fibers. As garments pass through, these rollers gently contact the fabric, transferring dirt and oils from the clothes onto their own surfaces. A secondary, integrated mechanism continuously cleans the rollers (e.g., with a scraper or micro-solvent spray which is then recovered), enabling continuous dirt removal from clothes without water.
included_members.abstraction: Continuous surface regeneration subsystem: Mechanism(s) that remove collected contaminants from the receiving surface in real time (mechanical, chemical, or combined) and recover or contain the removed soils for reuse or disposal.
included_members.label: Continuous surface regeneration subsystem
included_members.description: Mechanism(s) that remove collected contaminants from the receiving surface in real time (mechanical, chemical, or combined) and recover or contain the removed soils for reuse or disposal.
included_members.explanation: Regenerates the receiving surface by removing captured soils so it can keep accepting transferred dirt.

included_members.idea_text: A laundry appliance featuring a series of rotating polymer rollers whose surfaces are engineered to have a higher affinity for common dirt and oil molecules than for fabric fibers. A secondary, integrated mechanism continuously cleans the rollers (e.g., with a scraper or micro-solvent spray which is then recovered), enabling continuous dirt removal from clothes without water.
included_members.abstraction: Rotational conveyance and contact control: Mechanical arrangement that brings garments into controlled contact with the receiving surfaces (rotation, pressure, speed, and path) to effect transfer without excessive abrasion.
included_members.label: Rotational conveyance and contact control
included_members.description: Mechanical arrangement that brings garments into controlled contact with the receiving surfaces (rotation, pressure, speed, and path) to effect transfer without excessive abrasion.
included_members.explanation: Controls garment contact with the receiving medium to promote transfer onto the carrier surface.

included_members.idea_text: Garments are treated with a dissolvable or detachable nanocoating that has a stronger affinity for dirt/oils than for fabric fibers. After wear, the garments are placed in a gentle tumbling drum or cabinet. A mild, fabric-safe trigger (e.g., a specific light wavelength, a slight humidity change, or a very mild vibration) causes the nanocoating to rapidly delaminate or de-bond from the fabric, encapsulating and releasing the accumulated dirt. The shed nanocoating and dirt particles are then collected by a vacuum and filter system, leaving clean fabric with no water.
included_members.abstraction: Temporary contaminant‑binding removable coating: A thin, fabric‑compatible coating applied to garments that preferentially adsorbs or encapsulates dirt/oils and is engineered to be removed intact for disposal or filtration.
included_members.label: Temporary contaminant‑binding removable coating
included_members.description: A thin, fabric‑compatible coating applied to garments that preferentially adsorbs or encapsulates dirt/oils and is engineered to be removed intact for disposal or filtration.
included_members.explanation: Transfers soils to a removable coating carrier that is later removed for disposal/processing.

A mild, fabric-safe trigger (e.g., a specific light wavelength, a slight humidity change, or a very mild vibration) causes the nanocoating to rapidly delaminate or de-bond from the fabric, encapsulating and releasing the accumulated dirt. The shed nanocoating and dirt particles are then collected by a vacuum and filter system, leaving clean fabric with no water.
included_members.abstraction: Stimulus-responsive delamination mechanism: A fabric-safe mechanism by which a controlled stimulus (physical/chemical/optical) causes the coating to delaminate or change phase and release captured soils.
included_members.label: Stimulus-responsive delamination mechanism
included_members.description: A fabric-safe mechanism by which a controlled stimulus (physical/chemical/optical) causes the coating to delaminate or change phase and release captured soils.
included_members.explanation: Stimulus-triggered delamination is a mechanism for releasing/removing the contaminant-binding carrier.

included_members.idea_text: A system that applies a fine mist containing microscopic, biodegradable, decellularized bio-scaffold particles onto clothes. These particles are engineered to have a high affinity for common organic dirt and odors. After a short dwell time in a low-humidity environment, a mild trigger (e.g., specific light, very gentle vibration) initiates the controlled degradation or detachment of the bio-scaffold, taking the encapsulated dirt and odor molecules with it into a collection system, leaving clean garments with minimal water usage.
included_members.abstraction: Engineered biodegradable particulate binding agents: Microscopic particulate scaffolds engineered with high chemical/physical affinity for target soils and odor molecules that capture contaminants from textile fibers and carry them when removed.
included_members.label: Engineered biodegradable particulate binding agents
included_members.description: Microscopic particulate scaffolds engineered with high chemical/physical affinity for target soils and odor molecules that capture contaminants from textile fibers and carry them when removed.
included_members.explanation: Uses biodegradable particles that bind soils/odors and are then removed—transfer contaminants to a removable carrier.

included_members.abstraction: Aerosol/mist-based application system: A mechanism for producing and depositing a fine mist of the particulate agents onto garments to achieve uniform, low-volume coverage.
included_members.label: Aerosol/mist-based application system
included_members.description: A mechanism for producing and depositing a fine mist of the particulate agents onto garments to achieve uniform, low-volume coverage.
included_members.explanation: Mist deposits particulate binding agents onto fabric—delivery for the removable carrier approach.

included_members.abstraction: Controlled trigger for particle detachment/degradation and collection subsystem: A low-energy, specific trigger (e.g., wavelength-specific light, gentle vibration) that initiates predictable particle detachment or degradation combined with a collection path to remove particulates and bound contaminants.
included_members.label: Controlled trigger for particle detachment/degradation and collection subsystem
included_members.description: A low-energy, specific trigger (e.g., wavelength-specific light, gentle vibration) that initiates predictable particle detachment or degradation combined with a collection path to remove particulates and bound contaminants.
included_members.explanation: Trigger causes carrier particles to detach/degrade and be collected—removal/regeneration of the contaminant-bearing carrier.

included_members.idea_text: A system that applies a fine mist containing microscopic, biodegradable, decellularized bio-scaffold particles onto clothes. included_members.abstraction: Environmental dwell and conditioning control: Temporal and atmospheric control (e.g., reduced humidity, set dwell time) applied after deposition to promote stable binding of contaminants prior to triggering release.
included_members.label: Environmental dwell and conditioning control
included_members.description: Temporal and atmospheric control (e.g., reduced humidity, set dwell time) applied after deposition to promote stable binding of contaminants prior to triggering release.
included_members.explanation: Controls humidity/dwell to improve capture then release of the binding particles—process control supporting carrier-based transfer/removal.

included_members.idea_text: A dry-cleaning appliance featuring rollers made from a "smart" polymer whose surface energy can be tuned. As garments pass through, a mild stimulus (e.g., a specific light wavelength) temporarily increases the roller's adhesion, causing it to pick up dirt and oils from the fabric. A different stimulus then reduces the adhesion, causing the collected dirt to release from the roller into a waste receptacle, making the roller self-cleaning and reusable for continuous water-free garment cleaning.
included_members.abstraction: Stimulus-controlled reversible surface adhesion: A surface whose adhesion to contaminants is actively modulated by an external stimulus (e.g., wavelength-specific light, heat, or field) to alternate states for pickup (high adhesion) and release (low adhesion).
included_members.label: Stimulus-controlled reversible surface adhesion
included_members.description: A surface whose adhesion to contaminants is actively modulated by an external stimulus (e.g., wavelength-specific light, heat, or field) to alternate states for pickup (high adhesion) and release (low adhesion).
included_members.explanation: Transfers contaminants to a stimulus-switchable pickup surface that then releases them—soil transfer to removable/reusable carrier.

included_members.idea_text: A dry-cleaning appliance featuring rollers made from a "smart" polymer whose surface energy can be tuned. As garments pass through, a mild stimulus (e.g., a specific light wavelength) temporarily increases the roller's adhesion, causing it to pick up dirt and oils from the fabric. A different stimulus then reduces the adhesion, causing the collected dirt to release from the roller into a waste receptacle, making the roller self-cleaning and reusable for continuous water-free garment cleaning.
included_members.abstraction: Mechanical contact and autonomous debris deposition: A mechanical system that brings the responsive surface into contact with garments (rolling/pressure/relative motion), conveys collected debris to a discharge location, and sequences stimuli to offload material into a receptacle.
included_members.label: Mechanical contact and autonomous debris deposition
included_members.description: A mechanical system that brings the responsive surface into contact with garments (rolling/pressure/relative motion), conveys collected debris to a discharge location, and sequences stimuli to offload material into a receptacle.
included_members.explanation: Mechanically contacts fabric to pick up debris and then offloads it into a receptacle—carrier-based pickup/transport/release.

included_members.idea_text: A low-water garment cleaning chamber where clothes are immersed in a minimal volume of specialized, mildly aqueous solution. Fine, microscopic air bubbles are then introduced into the solution. These bubbles are engineered to selectively adhere to hydrophobic dirt, oils, and grease particles embedded in the fabric. The dirt-laden bubbles rise to the surface, forming a stable "froth" that is continuously skimmed off and filtered, effectively extracting contaminants from the garments with extremely low water usage and minimal mechanical agitation. The cleaned water is then recirculated.
included_members.abstraction: Microbubble-mediated selective adhesion and flotation separation: Generate and introduce microscopic gas bubbles that preferentially adhere to hydrophobic oils/grease on fabric; buoyant bubble–soil complexes rise and separate from garments.
included_members.label: Microbubble-mediated selective adhesion and flotation separation
included_members.description: Generate and introduce microscopic gas bubbles that preferentially adhere to hydrophobic oils/grease on fabric; buoyant bubble–soil complexes rise and separate from garments.
included_members.explanation: Transfers oils/grease onto microbubbles (an intermediate carrier phase) that can be separated from the textile.

included_members.idea_text: A low-water garment cleaning chamber where clothes are immersed in a minimal volume of specialized, mildly aqueous solution. Fine, microscopic air bubbles are then introduced into the solution. These bubbles are engineered to selectively adhere to hydrophobic dirt, oils, and grease particles embedded in the fabric. included_members.abstraction: Continuous froth accumulation and removal: maintain a contaminant-rich froth layer at the liquid surface and remove it continuously to extract concentrated soils and avoid recontamination.
included_members.label: Continuous froth accumulation and removal
included_members.description: maintain a contaminant-rich froth layer at the liquid surface and remove it continuously to extract concentrated soils and avoid recontamination.
included_members.explanation: Collects and removes contaminant-rich froth—removal of the intermediate carrier phase containing soils.

included_members.abstraction: Reliance on interfacial mechanisms over bulk mechanical agitation: Use adhesion and buoyancy-driven separation to remove soils, minimizing tumbling, shear, or agitation of fabrics.
included_members.label: Reliance on interfacial mechanisms over bulk mechanical agitation
included_members.description: Use adhesion and buoyancy-driven separation to remove soils, minimizing tumbling, shear, or agitation of fabrics.
included_members.explanation: Emphasizes interfacial adhesion/buoyancy separation (soil transfer to separable phase) over mechanical agitation.

included_members.idea_text: A laundry system where a fine, fabric-safe, dissolvable or semi-solid film-forming polymer solution is applied to the garment as a mist or thin coating. This film is engineered with adsorptive properties for dirt, oils, and odors. After a short drying/curing time in a low-humidity environment, the film solidifies, encapsulating the contaminants. It is then gently peeled off the garment by hand or an automated roller, carrying the accumulated dirt away, leaving clean fabric without water rinsing.
included_members.abstraction: Applied sacrificial adsorptive film: A film-forming layer applied onto fabric that selectively adsorbs/entraps contaminants and can be removed intact, carrying captured soils away from the textile.
included_members.label: Applied sacrificial adsorptive film
included_members.description: A film-forming layer applied onto fabric that selectively adsorbs/entraps contaminants and can be removed intact, carrying captured soils away from the textile.
included_members.explanation: A sacrificial adsorptive film that captures soils and is peeled off is transfer to a removable carrier.

included_members.idea_text: A laundry system where a fine, fabric-safe, dissolvable or semi-solid film-forming polymer solution is applied to the garment as a mist or thin coating. This film is engineered with adsorptive properties for dirt, oils, and odors. After a short drying/curing time in a low-humidity environment, the film solidifies, encapsulating the contaminants. It is then gently peeled off the garment by hand or an automated roller, carrying the accumulated dirt away, leaving clean fabric without water rinsing.
included_members.abstraction: Controlled apply–solidify–remove process: A sequence of operations (application as mist/thin coat, rapid drying/curing in controlled humidity, and mechanical peel/roll removal) that effects transfer of soils into the film without immersion.
included_members.label: Controlled apply–solidify–remove process
included_members.description: A sequence of operations (application as mist/thin coat, rapid drying/curing in controlled humidity, and mechanical peel/roll removal) that effects transfer of soils into the film without immersion.
included_members.explanation: Apply–solidify–remove sequence is the operational method for using a removable film carrier to take contaminants away.

included_members.idea_text: A laundry system where a fine, fabric-safe, dissolvable or semi-solid film-forming polymer solution is applied to the garment as a mist or thin coating. This film is engineered with adsorptive properties for dirt, oils, and odors. After a short drying/curing time in a low-humidity environment, the film solidifies, encapsulating the contaminants. It is then gently peeled off the garment by hand or an automated roller, carrying the accumulated dirt away, leaving clean fabric without water rinsing.
included_members.abstraction: Formulation and mechanical compatibility: Chemistry and mechanical properties chosen to be fabric-safe (nonreactive, non-staining, removable) and tuned to adhere to soils more strongly than to fibers.
included_members.label: Formulation and mechanical compatibility
included_members.description: Chemistry and mechanical properties chosen to be fabric-safe (nonreactive, non-staining, removable) and tuned to adhere to soils more strongly than to fibers.
included_members.explanation: Formulating a film to adhere to soils more than fibers is core to removable-carrier transfer cleaning.

included_members.idea_text: A dry or minimal-mist garment cleaning system that introduces a fine, fabric-safe ferrofluid mist onto clothes. This ferrofluid is engineered to preferentially bind to or encapsulate dirt and oil particles. After a brief dwell time, a localized, oscillating magnetic field is applied. This causes the dirt-laden ferrofluid to be agitated, moved, and then drawn out of the fabric by the magnetic field onto a collection surface, or into a separation chamber, effectively extracting dirt without bulk water. The ferrofluid can then be regenerated and reused.
included_members.abstraction: Magnetically-responsive contaminant-binding medium: A medium (fluid or particulate) formulated to selectively bind or encapsulate dirt/oil and incorporate magnetic responsiveness so it can be manipulated by magnetic fields.
included_members.label: Magnetically-responsive contaminant-binding medium
included_members.description: A medium (fluid or particulate) formulated to selectively bind or encapsulate dirt/oil and incorporate magnetic responsiveness so it can be manipulated by magnetic fields.
included_members.explanation: Uses a contaminant-binding medium (magnetically responsive) as a removable carrier to capture soils.

included_members.idea_text: A dry or minimal-mist garment cleaning system that introduces a fine, fabric-safe ferrofluid mist onto clothes. This ferrofluid is engineered to preferentially bind to or encapsulate dirt and oil particles. After a brief dwell time, a localized, oscillating magnetic field is applied. This causes the dirt-laden ferrofluid to be agitated, moved, and then drawn out of the fabric by the magnetic field onto a collection surface, or into a separation chamber, effectively extracting dirt without bulk water. The ferrofluid can then be regenerated and reused.
included_members.abstraction: Physical separation and regeneration subsystem: Mechanisms to capture the mobilized medium, separate entrained soils, and restore the medium for reuse without bulk-water disposal.
included_members.label: Physical separation and regeneration subsystem
included_members.description: Mechanisms to capture the mobilized medium, separate entrained soils, and restore the medium for reuse without bulk-water disposal.
included_members.explanation: Captures the medium, separates soils, and regenerates it—core is carrier reuse/removal workflow.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet that generates a fine, electrostatically charged mist of ultra-pure water (or a mild cleaning solution). These charged nano-droplets are engineered to act as "dirt nuclei," preferentially attracting and encapsulating fine particulate dirt, lint, and odor molecules from the garments via electrostatic forces and targeted surface chemistry. Once sufficiently agglomerated and weighted with contaminants, a controlled electrostatic field or gentle air current causes these dirt-laden droplets to coalesce and precipitate onto a collection surface at the bottom of the chamber, effectively "raining" the dirt out of the fabric without wetting the garment or requiring mechanical action.
included_members.abstraction: Sealed cabinet with dedicated collection infrastructure: Provide an enclosed chamber, containment seals, and dedicated collection surfaces or cartridges to capture precipitated contaminant mass and control environment.
included_members.label: Sealed cabinet with dedicated collection infrastructure
included_members.description: Provide an enclosed chamber, containment seals, and dedicated collection surfaces or cartridges to capture precipitated contaminant mass and control environment.
included_members.explanation: Relies on dedicated collection surfaces/cartridges to capture concentrated contaminant mass—transfer/capture to a removable medium.

included_members.idea_text: A dry-cleaning appliance featuring rollers made from a "smart" biomimetic polymer whose surface exhibits tunable, reversible bio-adhesion. As garments pass through, a mild, fabric-safe stimulus (e.g., a specific light wavelength, slight pH change, or mild electric field) activates the roller's surface to temporarily increase its adhesion, causing it to pick up a broad range of dirt, oils, and particulate matter from the fabric. A different stimulus then instantly reduces the adhesion, causing the collected dirt to release cleanly from the roller into a waste receptacle, making the roller self-cleaning and reusable for continuous, water-free garment cleaning.
included_members.abstraction: Stimuli-responsive reversible adhesive surface: A surface whose adhesion strength can be rapidly and repeatedly modulated by an external, fabric-safe stimulus to capture and then release a broad range of dirt and oils.
included_members.label: Stimuli-responsive reversible adhesive surface
included_members.description: A surface whose adhesion strength can be rapidly and repeatedly modulated by an external, fabric-safe stimulus to capture and then release a broad range of dirt and oils.
included_members.explanation: Captures contaminants via a reversible adhesive and then releases them elsewhere—transfer to an intermediate removable carrier mechanism.

included_members.idea_text: A dry-cleaning appliance featuring rollers made from a "smart" biomimetic polymer whose surface exhibits tunable, reversible bio-adhesion. As garments pass through, a mild, fabric-safe stimulus (e.g., a specific light wavelength, slight pH change, or mild electric field) activates the roller's surface to temporarily increase its adhesion, causing it to pick up a broad range of dirt, oils, and particulate matter from the fabric. A different stimulus then instantly reduces the adhesion, causing the collected dirt to release cleanly from the roller into a waste receptacle, making the roller self-cleaning and reusable for continuous, water-free garment cleaning.
included_members.abstraction: Rotating/rolling contact conveyor: A moving roller or set of rollers that guides garments past the adhesive surface with controlled pressure and speed to enable contaminant transfer.
included_members.label: Rotating/rolling contact conveyor
included_members.description: A moving roller or set of rollers that guides garments past the adhesive surface with controlled pressure and speed to enable contaminant transfer.
included_members.explanation: Uses controlled mechanical contact to transfer contaminants from garment onto an adhesive collection surface (a removable/intermediate carrier).

included_members.idea_text: A dry-cleaning appliance featuring rollers made from a "smart" biomimetic polymer whose surface exhibits tunable, reversible bio-adhesion. As garments pass through, a mild, fabric-safe stimulus (e.g., a specific light wavelength, slight pH change, or mild electric field) activates the roller's surface to temporarily increase its adhesion, causing it to pick up a broad range of dirt, oils, and particulate matter from the fabric. A different stimulus then instantly reduces the adhesion, causing the collected dirt to release cleanly from the roller into a waste receptacle, making the roller self-cleaning and reusable for continuous, water-free garment cleaning.
included_members.abstraction: Active release and collected-waste containment: A mechanism that applies the opposite stimulus and captures released debris into a waste receptacle while restoring the collection surface for reuse.
included_members.label: Active release and collected-waste containment
included_members.description: A mechanism that applies the opposite stimulus and captures released debris into a waste receptacle while restoring the collection surface for reuse.
included_members.explanation: Focuses on releasing collected debris from the collection surface into a receptacle and restoring the carrier for reuse—i.e., a transfer-to-carrier then removal/regen loop.

nodes.name: Water recycling and in-device purification loops
nodes.description: Treat greywater (membranes/electrocoagulation/multi-stage) and reuse it to cut net water demand.
idea_text: An advanced washing machine that incorporates an electrocoagulation system into its water purification loop. After a minimal initial wash with water, the greywater is treated with electrocoagulation to rapidly aggregate and remove dirt, dyes, and other contaminants. This pre-treatment significantly reduces the load on subsequent filtration, allowing the water to be recycled and reused much more efficiently for consecutive washes, minimizing fresh water intake.

Design a cleaning chamber where clothes are gently suspended in a minimal volume of water or a specialized, low-surface-tension cleaning solution. A system of diffusers beneath the garments introduces precisely controlled, pulsed streams of fine air or inert gas bubbles. These bubbles percolate through the fabric, creating a gentle "scrubbing" action that dislodges dirt and impurities, which are then collected from the circulating minimal liquid.

A specialized washing unit where clothes are suspended in a minimal amount of slightly conductive water or a weak electrolyte solution. The chamber incorporates alternating cation and anion exchange membranes. By applying an electric current, charged dirt particles (ions) and dissolved impurities are drawn out of the fabric and across the membranes, leaving cleaner fabric and significantly purified water for near-complete reuse within the closed system.

Develop cleaning agents or fabric coatings containing embedded or surface-applied smart polymers. When triggered (e.g., by a slight temperature change or pH adjustment in a low-humidity chamber with minimal mist), these polymers swell, physically pushing dirt and grime out of the fabric pores. Upon a reverse trigger, they contract, squeezing out any trapped impurities or dirty water, which is then collected, significantly reducing water usage for cleaning and rinsing.

A system where garments are briefly immersed in a minimal volume of a low-viscosity, fabric-safe MR fluid. A pulsed magnetic field is then applied, causing the fluid to momentarily thicken around the fabric fibers, effectively encapsulating and mechanically stressing embedded dirt and oil particles. When the field is removed, the fluid instantly thins, releasing the loosened dirt, which is then carried away by filtration. The fluid is continuously recycled and purified for subsequent uses with minimal loss and no water.

A washing machine integrated with a membrane distillation unit. After an initial minimal-water wash, the greywater is fed into the membrane distillation system. Water vapor passes through the hydrophobic membrane, leaving all dissolved and suspended contaminants in the concentrated brine. This purified water is then condensed and immediately recycled for the next wash cycle, achieving ultra-high water recovery and significantly reducing fresh water intake.

A low-water washing system that uses a mild, biodegradable solution containing engineered humic acid analogues or naturally derived humic substances. These compounds act as powerful chelating and dispersing agents, effectively binding to dirt, oils, and metal ions embedded in fabric. This complexation process makes the contaminants easier to rinse away with a minimal amount of water, which is then purified and recycled through a system optimized to separate the humic-dirt complexes.

A sealed garment cabinet that uses a small, contained reservoir of water. This water is rapidly heated to generate superheated, dry steam (vapor without liquid droplets). This superheated steam is circulated through the garments, effectively sterilizing, deodorizing, and loosening superficial dirt and oils through thermal shock and vapor action. The steam then cools, condenses, and is immediately collected, filtered, and returned to the reservoir for continuous reuse, achieving powerful cleaning with extremely low water replenishment.

A washing machine integrated with a forward osmosis system. After an initial, minimal-water wash cycle, the greywater (feed solution) is pumped to one side of an FO membrane. A highly concentrated, reusable draw solution is on the other side. Clean water is naturally pulled from the greywater through the membrane, leaving all contaminants and dirt in the concentrated feed solution, and the purified water is then recycled back into the wash system for continuous reuse, drastically reducing fresh water consumption.

A garment cleaning system that employs a fine mist of water containing specialized, fabric-safe, marine-derived or inspired chelating agents. These agents are designed to selectively bind to metallic ions, mineral deposits (e.g., from hard water stains), and certain organic pollutants commonly found in dirt and stains. Once chelated, the contaminants become more soluble or easily dislodged, allowing for effective removal with significantly reduced water rinsing, which is then filtered to remove the chelated compounds for safe disposal or recovery.

A low-water garment cleaning chamber where clothes are immersed in a minimal volume of specialized, mildly aqueous solution. Fine, microscopic air bubbles are then introduced into the solution. These bubbles are engineered to selectively adhere to hydrophobic dirt, oils, and grease particles embedded in the fabric. The dirt-laden bubbles rise to the surface, forming a stable "froth" that is continuously skimmed off and filtered, effectively extracting contaminants from the garments with extremely low water usage and minimal mechanical agitation. The cleaned water is then recirculated.

A washing machine with an integrated, ultra-efficient closed-loop water purification system. After each wash cycle, the greywater undergoes micro-filtration, reverse osmosis, and UV sterilization, making it pristine and immediately reusable for the next load, virtually eliminating water discharge and demand.

A closed-loop, high-pressure cleaning chamber that exposes garments to a minimal amount of near-critical water (e.g., 250-350 °C, 5-15 MPa). In this state, water effectively dissolves and cleanses organic dirt, oils, and greases from fabric fibers without harsh detergents. After a short cycle, the system rapidly cools and depressurizes the water, causing contaminants to precipitate out for easy filtration and removal. The purified water is then recycled, achieving powerful cleaning with dramatically reduced water consumption and no chemical discharge.

included_members.idea_text: Develop cleaning agents or fabric coatings containing embedded or surface-applied smart polymers. nodes.name: Sensing-guided targeting and spot-treatment automation
nodes.description: Detect where cleaning is needed and apply localized treatment instead of whole-garment cycles.
idea_text: A specialized laundry treatment system where clothes are exposed to a controlled blast of fine dry ice pellets. The sublimation effect physically removes embedded dirt and grime, similar to agitation but without any water, making it ideal for certain fabrics or for quick refresh cycles where water isn't necessary.

A targeted spray or applicator pen that dispenses a concentrated blend of fabric-safe enzymes onto specific stains. After a short dwell time, the broken-down stain components can be wiped away with a damp cloth or absorbed by a dry, absorbent pad, eliminating the need for a full water wash for localized soiling.

A garment cleaning chamber that exposes clothes to precisely tuned mechanical vibrations or sonic frequencies. These frequencies are engineered to resonate with the physical bonds between dirt particles and fabric fibers, effectively loosening and detaching dirt without requiring bulk water. The dislodged particles are then collected by a vacuum or filtration system.

A targeted handheld device or a small chamber with specialized electrodes. Garments, or specific soiled areas, are exposed to a minimal film of a slightly conductive, fabric-safe electrolyte solution. An electric current is then precisely applied, generating reactive species or directly oxidizing organic dirt, stains, and odor molecules on the fabric surface. These contaminants are electrochemically degraded into simpler, water-soluble, or volatile compounds, which are then wiped away or evaporated, minimizing water usage and avoiding harsh chemicals.

A garment cleaning system where a low-power, pulsed infrared laser scans the fabric. The laser energy is tuned to be preferentially absorbed by dirt particles or the interface layer, causing rapid, localized thermal expansion and contraction. This generates micro-scale mechanical shockwaves that break the adhesive bonds of dirt particles, which are then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.

A garment chamber where clothes are exposed to precisely tuned RF or microwave fields. The frequency and power are optimized to selectively heat and slightly expand/soften the dirt particles or the interface layer between dirt and fabric, without significantly heating the fabric itself. This localized thermal stress, combined with gentle mechanical tumbling or air currents, causes the dirt to lose adhesion and be dislodged. A filtration system then collects the removed particles, providing a water-free cleaning method.

A sealed garment cabinet that uses a small, contained reservoir of water. This water is rapidly heated to generate superheated, dry steam (vapor without liquid droplets). This superheated steam is circulated through the garments, effectively sterilizing, deodorizing, and loosening superficial dirt and oils through thermal shock and vapor action. The steam then cools, condenses, and is immediately collected, filtered, and returned to the reservoir for continuous reuse, achieving powerful cleaning with extremely low water replenishment.

A smart robotic system, integrated into a laundry hamper or closet, that uses optical sensors to detect stains and dirt. It then applies a micro-dose of targeted cleaning solution or uses a dry micro-brush to remove localized grime, minimizing the need for full-garment, water-intensive washing.

A cleaning chamber where garments are introduced and suspended on a precisely controlled air cushion (an "air film") generated from below. This eliminates friction and mechanical wear. While suspended, targeted, high-velocity air nozzles (acting as siphons or localized vacuums) are directed at the garment from above, actively lifting and extracting dry dust, lint, and superficial grime from the fabric fibers, collecting them in a filter system, all without water or direct contact.

A precision stain removal device that generates and applies microscopic, targeted droplets of a highly concentrated, fabric-safe cleaning agent. Each droplet is designed to penetrate and then encapsulate a specific dirt particle or stain molecule. After a short dwell time, a mild vacuum or absorbent pad removes these dirt-encapsulating droplets, providing highly localized and efficient stain removal with minimal liquid use, preventing spreading and eliminating the need for a full wash.

A garment "freshener" chamber that uses UV-C light to sanitize and deodorize clothes, especially those that are not visibly dirty but need refreshing. This significantly reduces the frequency of water-intensive washes, particularly for delicate items or outerwear.

A sealed laundry chamber where garments are held taut. A system of micro-nozzles precisely injects localized micro-bursts of a fabric-safe, miscible, low-boiling-point solvent (in its gas phase) directly into the fabric weave. This gaseous solvent deeply penetrates and dissolves hydrophobic dirt and oils. A gentle, continuous vacuum then pulls the dirt-laden gas out, which is subsequently condensed, purified, and recycled for continuous reuse, providing highly targeted and water-free cleaning.

A specialized garment refresh chamber where clothes are briefly exposed to a controlled, low-energy electron beam. The electron beam's energy is tuned to target and disrupt the molecular bonds of organic dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on the fabric surface. These contaminants are then converted into volatile byproducts or easily detachable fragments that are removed by a gentle vacuum system, providing a deep, dry, and chemical-free surface cleaning and deodorization, minimizing the need for water washes.

A garment cleaning station equipped with a low-power, pulsed laser system. Optical sensors identify soiled areas, and the laser is precisely tuned (wavelength, pulse energy) to be selectively absorbed by common dirt, oils, or stain chromophores. The absorbed energy causes rapid, localized micro-vaporization or thermal decomposition of the contaminant, effectively "ablating" it from the fabric surface without heating or damaging the surrounding fibers. A gentle vacuum collects the resulting microscopic debris, providing an extremely targeted, water-free, and residue-free cleaning method.

A specialized laundry drum or cabinet with embedded micro-electrodes near the fabric surface. When clothes are present, a precisely controlled, short, high-energy electrical pulse is applied. This generates localized, micro-scale mechanical shockwaves within the fabric itself or at the fabric-dirt interface, effectively breaking the adhesive bonds of embedded dirt and grime without damaging the fibers. The dislodged particles are then removed by a gentle vacuum and filtration system, providing a water-free cleaning method that targets deeply embedded contaminants.

A smart appliance or handheld device that uses optical sensors to detect stains. It then precisely "inkjets" micro-droplets of a concentrated, fabric-safe cleaning solution onto the stain. After a brief dwell time, a focused burst of warm air or a micro-vacuum system rapidly evaporates the liquid and lifts the dissolved/suspended dirt, requiring minimal cleaning fluid and no bulk water rinsing.

Integrate a bioluminescent detection system into a laundry appliance or garment cabinet. After a minimal-water cleaning cycle (e.g., misting, plasma), a mild, fabric-safe bioluminescent agent is briefly applied or activated. If significant organic residues (like bacteria, body oils) remain, they trigger a light emission, indicating the need for further cleaning or a more intensive approach. This smart feedback loop ensures that clothes are only cleaned as much as necessary, significantly reducing unnecessary water consumption.

A highly specialized garment cleaning station equipped with a low-energy, broad, non-damaging ion beam. Optical sensors identify and map individual dirt particles or stains. The ion beam is then directed to these specific micro-regions, where the kinetic energy of the ions physically dislodges and sputters away the contaminant molecules from the fabric surface without damaging the fibers. A gentle vacuum system collects the sputtered debris, providing an ultra-precise, water-free, and residue-free spot cleaning method.

A flat cleaning surface or a drum lining integrated with an array of microscopic, fabric-safe MEMS actuators. When a garment makes contact, optical sensors identify individual dirt particles. The micro-actuators then precisely extend or vibrate locally, gently lifting or dislodging specific dirt particles from the fabric fibers. These particles are then drawn away by a localized micro-vacuum system, enabling highly targeted, dry, and extremely gentle particulate removal from clothing without water.
