nodes.name: Actuation parameter tuning and closed-loop safety control
nodes.description: Adjust treatment intensity, timing, and energy/mechanical parameters based on fabric/soil sensing, including feedback control, optimization, and interlocks to prevent damage.
idea_text: A specialized laundry treatment system where clothes are exposed to a controlled blast of fine dry ice pellets. The sublimation effect physically removes embedded dirt and grime, similar to agitation but without any water, making it ideal for certain fabrics or for quick refresh cycles where water isn't necessary.

A garment cleaning chamber that exposes clothes to precisely tuned mechanical vibrations or sonic frequencies. These frequencies are engineered to resonate with the physical bonds between dirt particles and fabric fibers, effectively loosening and detaching dirt without requiring bulk water. The dislodged particles are then collected by a vacuum or filtration system.

A garment cleaning system where a low-power, pulsed infrared laser scans the fabric. The laser energy is tuned to be preferentially absorbed by dirt particles or the interface layer, causing rapid, localized thermal expansion and contraction. This generates micro-scale mechanical shockwaves that break the adhesive bonds of dirt particles, which are then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.

A garment chamber where clothes are exposed to precisely tuned RF or microwave fields. The frequency and power are optimized to selectively heat and slightly expand/soften the dirt particles or the interface layer between dirt and fabric, without significantly heating the fabric itself. This localized thermal stress, combined with gentle mechanical tumbling or air currents, causes the dirt to lose adhesion and be dislodged. A filtration system then collects the removed particles, providing a water-free cleaning method.

A cleaning chamber where garments are introduced and suspended on a precisely controlled air cushion (an "air film") generated from below. This eliminates friction and mechanical wear. While suspended, targeted, high-velocity air nozzles (acting as siphons or localized vacuums) are directed at the garment from above, actively lifting and extracting dry dust, lint, and superficial grime from the fabric fibers, collecting them in a filter system, all without water or direct contact.

A specialized laundry drum or cabinet with embedded micro-electrodes near the fabric surface. When clothes are present, a precisely controlled, short, high-energy electrical pulse is applied. This generates localized, micro-scale mechanical shockwaves within the fabric itself or at the fabric-dirt interface, effectively breaking the adhesive bonds of embedded dirt and grime without damaging the fibers. The dislodged particles are then removed by a gentle vacuum and filtration system, providing a water-free cleaning method that targets deeply embedded contaminants.

nodes.name: Spot-treatment system integration and automation hardware
nodes.description: Physical platforms and control sequencing that integrate sensing, positioning, dispensing, dwell, and removal into an automated spot-treatment workflow (robotic/actuator integration, cycle orchestration).
idea_text: A smart robotic system, integrated into a laundry hamper or closet, that uses optical sensors to detect stains and dirt. It then applies a micro-dose of targeted cleaning solution or uses a dry micro-brush to remove localized grime, minimizing the need for full-garment, water-intensive washing.

A smart appliance or handheld device that uses optical sensors to detect stains. It then precisely "inkjets" micro-droplets of a concentrated, fabric-safe cleaning solution onto the stain. These particles are then drawn away by a localized micro-vacuum system, enabling highly targeted, dry, and extremely gentle particulate removal from clothing without water.

included_members.description: Control logic, timing, feedback, and user/device interfaces that sequence sensing, dispensing, dwell, and removal and define device form factor.
included_members.explanation: System-level integration/control that sequences sensing, dosing, dwell, and extraction for automated spot-treatment.

included_members.idea_text: A flat cleaning surface or a drum lining integrated with an array of microscopic, fabric-safe MEMS actuators. When a garment makes contact, optical sensors identify individual dirt particles. The micro-actuators then precisely extend or vibrate locally, gently lifting or dislodging specific dirt particles from the fabric fibers. These particles are then drawn away by a localized micro-vacuum system, enabling highly targeted, dry, and extremely gentle particulate removal from clothing without water.
included_members.abstraction: Surface-integrated module: Physical integration and layout of sensing-actuation-extraction elements into a liner or flat surface that contacts clothing.
included_members.label: Surface-integrated module
included_members.description: Physical integration and layout of sensing-actuation-extraction elements into a liner or flat surface that contacts clothing.
included_members.explanation: Integrates sensing, actuation, and extraction into a single contacting module/platform—spot-treatment system integration hardware.

nodes.name: Enclosed fixtures, chambers, and controlled extraction environments
nodes.description: Constrain garments and manage the local environment (sealed cabinet/fixture, tensioning, controlled atmosphere, airflow shaping/extraction) to enable repeatable localized treatment and capture.
idea_text: A targeted handheld device or a small chamber with specialized electrodes. Garments, or specific soiled areas, are exposed to a minimal film of a slightly conductive, fabric-safe electrolyte solution. An electric current is then precisely applied, generating reactive species or directly oxidizing organic dirt, stains, and odor molecules on the fabric surface. These contaminants are electrochemically degraded into simpler, water-soluble, or volatile compounds, which are then wiped away or evaporated, minimizing water usage and avoiding harsh chemicals.

A sealed laundry chamber where garments are held taut. A system of micro-nozzles precisely injects localized micro-bursts of a fabric-safe, miscible, low-boiling-point solvent (in its gas phase) directly into the fabric weave. This gaseous solvent deeply penetrates and dissolves hydrophobic dirt and oils. A gentle, continuous vacuum then pulls the dirt-laden gas out, which is subsequently condensed, purified, and recycled for continuous reuse, providing highly targeted and water-free cleaning.

A sealed garment cabinet that generates a fine, electrostatically charged mist of ultra-pure water (or a mild cleaning solution). These charged nano-droplets are engineered to act as "dirt nuclei," preferentially attracting and encapsulating fine particulate dirt, lint, and odor molecules from the garments via electrostatic forces and targeted surface chemistry. Once sufficiently agglomerated and weighted with contaminants, a controlled electrostatic field or gentle air current causes these dirt-laden droplets to coalesce and precipitate onto a collection surface at the bottom of the chamber, effectively "raining" the dirt out of the fabric without wetting the garment or requiring mechanical action.

nodes.name: Electrostatic charging and Coulombic capture
nodes.description: Impose/retain electric charge on fabric and particles, then use electrostatic attraction/repulsion to move particulates to a collector; includes charge-enabling environmental control.
idea_text: Design fabrics or fabric liners with embedded electret properties. As clothes tumble or are gently agitated in a dry environment, the electret material actively generates electric fields that either repel charged dust and dirt particles from the fabric surface or attract them to a dedicated, removable collection component, effectively cleaning without water.

Design a laundry drum that tumbles clothes in a low-humidity environment, inducing an electrostatic charge on both fabric and dirt particles. The charged dirt particles are then attracted to an oppositely charged collector plate or filter within the drum, effectively "lifting" them off the fabric without water.

nodes.name: Electrokinetic transport in thin conductive media
nodes.description: Use electric fields/currents through minimal conductive films or low-volume electrolyte to drive electrophoresis/electro-osmosis that pulls contaminants out of fibers toward electrodes/membranes.
idea_text: A specialized washing unit where clothes are suspended in a minimal amount of slightly conductive water or a weak electrolyte solution. The chamber incorporates alternating cation and anion exchange membranes. By applying an electric current, charged dirt particles (ions) and dissolved impurities are drawn out of the fabric and across the membranes, leaving cleaner fabric and significantly purified water for near-complete reuse within the closed system.

A laundry chamber designed to expose garments to a very thin, fabric-safe, conductive liquid film (e.g., minimal water with a mild electrolyte). An oscillating electric field is applied across the fabric. Dirt and oil particles, which often carry a net electrical charge, are made to migrate through the liquid film towards specialized collector electrodes or a permeable membrane, effectively "scavenging" them off the fabric with significantly less water and no mechanical scrubbing.

A targeted handheld device or a small chamber with specialized electrodes. Garments, or specific soiled areas, are exposed to a minimal film of a slightly conductive, fabric-safe electrolyte solution. An electric current is then precisely applied, generating reactive species or directly oxidizing organic dirt, stains, and odor molecules on the fabric surface. These contaminants are electrochemically degraded into simpler, water-soluble, or volatile compounds, which are then wiped away or evaporated, minimizing water usage and avoiding harsh chemicals.

A specialized laundry chamber or drum where clothes are immersed in a very minimal volume of water with a mild electrolyte. An electric potential is applied across the fabric. This induces electro-osmotic flow, drawing dirty water (and dissolved/suspended contaminants) directly out of the fabric pores towards a collection electrode or permeable membrane, effectively "flushing" the fabric internally with minimal bulk water movement or mechanical agitation. The collected dirty water is then processed for disposal or further purification.

nodes.name: Electrowetting and field-driven droplet transport
nodes.description: Use electric fields to move/oscillate micro-droplets on fabric for agitation and to route contaminated droplets to a collection port.
idea_text: A flat or slightly curved surface where garments are laid. A system of precise nozzles applies micro-droplets of a specialized, low-surface-tension cleaning solution to stained areas. Electrodes beneath the surface then apply electric fields to dynamically move, oscillate, or "scrub" these droplets over the fabric, dislodging dirt. The dirty droplets are then electro-wetting-guided to a collection port, allowing for extremely targeted cleaning with minuscule water usage.

nodes.name: Pulsed electric micro-disruption at the interface
nodes.description: Apply pulsed electrical energy/fields to create localized impulses or bond-disrupting effects that weaken adhesion/biofilms to enable detachment with minimal liquid.
idea_text: A specialized laundry drum or cabinet with embedded micro-electrodes near the fabric surface. When clothes are present, a precisely controlled, short, high-energy electrical pulse is applied. This generates localized, micro-scale mechanical shockwaves within the fabric itself or at the fabric-dirt interface, effectively breaking the adhesive bonds of embedded dirt and grime without damaging the fibers. The dislodged particles are then removed by a gentle vacuum and filtration system, providing a water-free cleaning method that targets deeply embedded contaminants.

A minimal-water washing chamber where clothes are briefly exposed to a mild, fabric-safe aqueous solution. Pulsed electric fields are then applied across the solution and fabric. These pulses disrupt the integrity of microbial biofilms (which encase much of the dirt and odor-causing bacteria) and weaken the electrostatic or cohesive bonds of embedded dirt particles, making them easier to detach and rinse away with significantly less water and agitation.

nodes.name: Magnetic-field actuation and extraction
nodes.description: Apply time-varying/spatial magnetic fields to mobilize magnetically responsive carriers/medium and transport them out of textile into a capture zone.
idea_text: Develop a cleaning system that introduces microscopic, fabric-safe magnetic particles (e.g., in a fine mist or dry powder form) engineered to selectively adhere to dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on garments. After a brief tumbling period to ensure contact, a powerful, oscillating magnetic field is applied to pull these dirt-laden magnetic particles out of the fabric and into a collection chamber for separation and potential reuse.

A dry or minimal-mist garment cleaning system that introduces a fine, fabric-safe ferrofluid mist onto clothes. This ferrofluid is engineered to preferentially bind to or encapsulate dirt and oil particles. After a brief dwell time, a localized, oscillating magnetic field is applied. This causes the dirt-laden ferrofluid to be agitated, moved, and then drawn out of the fabric by the magnetic field onto a collection surface, or into a separation chamber, effectively extracting dirt without bulk water. The ferrofluid can then be regenerated and reused.

nodes.name: Acoustic/ultrasonic radiation-force detachment and aggregation
nodes.description: Generate acoustic/ultrasonic fields (standing waves, radiation forces) to dislodge particles and/or move and aggregate suspended contaminants for directed capture/filtration.
idea_text: A specialized enclosed chamber where garments are suspended and gently agitated by powerful, non-audible ultrasonic standing waves. This contactless "tumbling" and manipulation effectively loosens dry dirt, dust, and lint from the fabric fibers. A gentle filtered airflow simultaneously draws away the dislodged particles into a collection system, providing a dry, contact-free cleaning and refreshing process without any water or mechanical wear on the fabric.

A minimal-water wash system where clothes are immersed in a very small volume of water containing a low concentration of cleaning agents. High-frequency acoustic transducers are precisely arrayed to generate acoustic radiation forces that gently 'push' and aggregate dirt particles within the water towards a specific collection zone or filter, without requiring bulk fluid flow or mechanical agitation of the clothes. This allows for highly efficient dirt removal from the water, enabling near-complete water recirculation and minimal fresh water input for effective cleaning.

nodes.name: Surface acoustic wave interface agitation
nodes.description: Use surface-propagating vibrations at a contact interface to impart localized oscillatory forces into fabric for contaminant detachment; includes coupling/contact control.
idea_text: A specialized cleaning plate or drum lining made of a piezoelectric material. Clothes are gently pressed against or tumbled on this surface. Interdigitated electrodes on the surface generate high-frequency SAWs that propagate along the interface with the fabric. These SAWs exert precise, localized mechanical forces on dirt particles at the fabric surface, effectively "sweeping" or "vibrating" them off without needing bulk water, solvents, or bulk ultrasonic cavitation. The dislodged dirt is collected by an integrated vacuum system.

nodes.name: Thermal-gradient and selective-heating driven release/transport
nodes.description: Use temperature gradients or field-induced localized heating/cooling to weaken adhesion (soften/embrittle) and/or drive particle motion toward a collector.
idea_text: A specialized garment cleaning chamber that briefly chills clothes to cryogenic temperatures (e.g., using a controlled blast of chilled air or liquid nitrogen vapor). This causes embedded dirt, chewing gum, or stubborn stains to become brittle, allowing them to be easily dislodged and vibrated or brushed off the fabric without the need for water or solvents.

A garment chamber where clothes are exposed to precisely tuned RF or microwave fields. The frequency and power are optimized to selectively heat and slightly expand/soften the dirt particles or the interface layer between dirt and fabric, without significantly heating the fabric itself. This localized thermal stress, combined with gentle mechanical tumbling or air currents, causes the dirt to lose adhesion and be dislodged. A filtration system then collects the removed particles, providing a water-free cleaning method.

A sealed garment cabinet or tumbling drum equipped with a heating and cooling system to create a controlled temperature gradient across the fabric surface in a dry environment. As garments are gently tumbled or suspended, the temperature gradient induces thermophoretic forces that gently drive fine dust, lint, and superficial particulate dirt away from the warmer fabric surface towards a colder collection plate or filter, effectively removing dry contaminants without water.

nodes.name: Field-modulated medium rheology for timed shear
nodes.description: Switch a working medium between fluid/solid-like states using an applied field to transiently encapsulate contaminants and apply controlled mechanical stress for release.
idea_text: A system where garments are briefly immersed in a minimal volume of a low-viscosity, fabric-safe MR fluid. A pulsed magnetic field is then applied, causing the fluid to momentarily thicken around the fabric fibers, effectively encapsulating and mechanically stressing embedded dirt and oil particles. When the field is removed, the fluid instantly thins, releasing the loosened dirt, which is then carried away by filtration. The fluid is continuously recycled and purified for subsequent uses with minimal loss and no water.

nodes.name: Optical/ion-beam localized energy ejection
nodes.description: Direct focused light or ion energy to micro-regions to cause local thermal/mechanical effects or sputtering that ejects contaminants while limiting bulk wet processing.
idea_text: A garment cleaning system where a very fine, dry, and biodegradable micro-abrasive powder (e.g., cellulose beads) is gently dusted onto clothes. A precisely controlled, low-power pulsed laser beam then scans the fabric. The laser energy interacts with the micro-abrasive particles, causing them to gently 'lift' or 'etch' away dirt and grime from the fabric surface through localized photomechanical action. The dirty micro-abrasive is then vacuumed away, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.

A garment cleaning system where a low-power, pulsed infrared laser scans the fabric. The laser energy is tuned to be preferentially absorbed by dirt particles or the interface layer, causing rapid, localized thermal expansion and contraction. This generates micro-scale mechanical shockwaves that break the adhesive bonds of dirt particles, which are then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.

A highly specialized garment cleaning station equipped with a low-energy, broad, non-damaging ion beam. Optical sensors identify and map individual dirt particles or stains. The ion beam is then directed to these specific micro-regions, where the kinetic energy of the ions physically dislodges and sputters away the contaminant molecules from the fabric surface without damaging the fibers. A gentle vacuum system collects the sputtered debris, providing an ultra-precise, water-free, and residue-free spot cleaning method.

Garments are manufactured with embedded or surface-applied microscopic, optically responsive elements (e.g., plasmonic nanoparticles or specialized polymer fibers). When placed in a dry cleaning chamber and illuminated with precisely tuned, non-damaging light wavelengths, these elements preferentially absorb energy. This causes rapid, localized micro-thermal expansion and contraction or phase change directly at the fabric-dirt interface, physically agitating and dislodging dirt particles. A gentle airflow then removes the loosened particles, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method leveraging engineered fabric properties.

nodes.name: Charged droplet scavenging and field-driven precipitation
nodes.description: Generate charged micro/nano droplets that bind contaminants, then use fields/flow to agglomerate and precipitate the dirt-laden droplets to a collection location.
idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet that generates a fine, electrostatically charged mist of ultra-pure water (or a mild cleaning solution). These charged nano-droplets are engineered to act as "dirt nuclei," preferentially attracting and encapsulating fine particulate dirt, lint, and odor molecules from the garments via electrostatic forces and targeted surface chemistry. Once sufficiently agglomerated and weighted with contaminants, a controlled electrostatic field or gentle air current causes these dirt-laden droplets to coalesce and precipitate onto a collection surface at the bottom of the chamber, effectively "raining" the dirt out of the fabric without wetting the garment or requiring mechanical action.

nodes.name: Aerodynamic lifting and entrainment
nodes.description: Use directed airflow (jets, vortices, laminar sheets, micro-flows) to apply shear/pressure forces that lift particulates from fabric and carry them into a removal stream.
idea_text: A specialized laundry chamber or drum designed with precisely positioned nozzles that generate high-velocity, controlled air vortices around and through the garments. These aerodynamic forces would gently lift and carry away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial particulate dirt from fabric fibers, collecting them in a filter system, effectively de-soiling clothes without any water.

A specialized enclosed chamber where garments are suspended and gently agitated by powerful, non-audible ultrasonic standing waves. This contactless "tumbling" and manipulation effectively loosens dry dirt, dust, and lint from the fabric fibers. A gentle filtered airflow simultaneously draws away the dislodged particles into a collection system, providing a dry, contact-free cleaning and refreshing process without any water or mechanical wear on the fabric.

A garment cleaning chamber equipped with multi-modal transducers capable of generating a broadband spectrum of mechanical waves, including both compressional and shear waves, that propagate through the fabric. These complex vibrations are designed to physically agitate and break the adhesion of diverse dirt particles (dry dust, sticky grime) from fibers across various fabric types. Dislodged particles are then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration system, achieving dry cleaning without specific reliance on a single resonance.

A garment cleaning system where a low-power, pulsed infrared laser scans the fabric. The laser energy is tuned to be preferentially absorbed by dirt particles or the interface layer, causing rapid, localized thermal expansion and contraction. This generates micro-scale mechanical shockwaves that break the adhesive bonds of dirt particles, which are then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.

A sealed garment cleaning chamber where clothes are suspended. An array of micro-jets or pulsators generates highly localized, tunable air pressure pulsations around individual fabric fibers. These rapid, non-linear air movements create micro-turbulences and pressure differentials that physically dislodge dry dirt, dust, and lint particles without harsh mechanical contact or significant bulk air movement. Dislodged particles are then quietly drawn into a filter system by a very gentle, continuous background flow.

A cleaning chamber where garments are introduced and suspended on a precisely controlled air cushion (an "air film") generated from below. This eliminates friction and mechanical wear. While suspended, targeted, high-velocity air nozzles (acting as siphons or localized vacuums) are directed at the garment from above, actively lifting and extracting dry dust, lint, and superficial grime from the fabric fibers, collecting them in a filter system, all without water or direct contact.

A garment refreshing cabinet where an internal electric field generates a controlled "ion wind" or electrohydrodynamic flow. This silent, gentle, localized air current is directed across the fabric surfaces, physically dislodging dry dust, lint, and carrying away odor molecules without any moving mechanical parts. The dislodged particles and odors are then collected by an integrated filter and purification system, providing a water-free and gentle cleaning method.

Garments are woven with a percentage of specialized, micro-scale stimuli-responsive fibers (e.g., pH or humidity-sensitive polymers). When the garment is exposed to a minimal, fine mist of water with a specific pH, these embedded fibers swell, physically pushing outwards and dislodging dirt particles from the fabric structure. A subsequent change (e.g., mild heating or pH neutralization) causes the fibers to shrink, releasing the loosened dirt, which is then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration system, achieving cleaning with very low water input.

A sealed garment cabinet where clothes are suspended. Compressed air is fed into an array of miniature vortex tubes directed at the garments. The resulting high-velocity, temperature-differentiated air streams create targeted aerodynamic forces to dislodge dry dust and lint (mechanical cleaning) and simultaneously generate localized thermophoretic effects, pushing fine particles away from the fabric towards a collection filter. This provides a dry, water-free, and energy-efficient cleaning process.

A specialized garment refresh chamber where clothes are briefly exposed to a controlled, low-energy electron beam. The electron beam's energy is tuned to target and disrupt the molecular bonds of organic dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on the fabric surface. These contaminants are then converted into volatile byproducts or easily detachable fragments that are removed by a gentle vacuum system, providing a deep, dry, and chemical-free surface cleaning and deodorization, minimizing the need for water washes.

Garments are manufactured with embedded or surface-applied microscopic, optically responsive elements (e.g., plasmonic nanoparticles or specialized polymer fibers). When placed in a dry cleaning chamber and illuminated with precisely tuned, non-damaging light wavelengths, these elements preferentially absorb energy. This causes rapid, localized micro-thermal expansion and contraction or phase change directly at the fabric-dirt interface, physically agitating and dislodging dirt particles. A gentle airflow then removes the loosened particles, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method leveraging engineered fabric properties.

A garment refreshing cabinet with internal curved surfaces and precisely angled air nozzles designed to exploit the Coandă effect. A continuous, laminar sheet of high-velocity air is generated and directed to flow smoothly over the garments. This non-turbulent, wall-attached airflow creates a gentle, continuous shear force across the fabric surfaces, effectively lifting and carrying away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial particulate matter without harsh mechanical contact. The dirt-laden air is then silently directed into a high-efficiency filter system, providing a very gentle, water-free cleaning and deodorizing method.

These contaminants are then converted into volatile byproducts or easily detachable fragments that are removed by a gentle vacuum system, providing a deep, dry, and chemical-free surface cleaning and deodorization, minimizing the need for water washes.
included_members.abstraction: Gentle vacuum/airflow removal of byproducts and fragments: Use low-pressure suction or directed airflow to extract volatile decomposition products and loose fragments from the garment surface and transport them to filters or exhaust pathways.
included_members.label: Gentle vacuum/airflow removal of byproducts and fragments
included_members.description: Use low-pressure suction or directed airflow to extract volatile decomposition products and loose fragments from the garment surface and transport them to filters or exhaust pathways.
included_members.explanation: Uses suction/airflow to carry away volatile byproducts and fragments (airflow entrainment removal).

included_members.idea_text: Garments are manufactured with embedded or surface-applied microscopic, optically responsive elements (e.g., plasmonic nanoparticles or specialized polymer fibers). When placed in a dry cleaning chamber and illuminated with precisely tuned, non-damaging light wavelengths, these elements preferentially absorb energy. This causes rapid, localized micro-thermal expansion and contraction or phase change directly at the fabric-dirt interface, physically agitating and dislodging dirt particles. A gentle airflow then removes the loosened particles, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method leveraging engineered fabric properties.
included_members.abstraction: Controlled airflow-based particle removal: Apply a gentle, directed airflow to carry away loosened particles from the fabric surface into filters or collectors without wetting.
included_members.label: Controlled airflow-based particle removal
included_members.description: Apply a gentle, directed airflow to carry away loosened particles from the fabric surface into filters or collectors without wetting.
included_members.explanation: Directed airflow entrains and carries away loosened particles for capture without wetting.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refreshing cabinet with internal curved surfaces and precisely angled air nozzles designed to exploit the Coandă effect. A continuous, laminar sheet of high-velocity air is generated and directed to flow smoothly over the garments. This non-turbulent, wall-attached airflow creates a gentle, continuous shear force across the fabric surfaces, effectively lifting and carrying away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial particulate matter without harsh mechanical contact. The dirt-laden air is then silently directed into a high-efficiency filter system, providing a very gentle, water-free cleaning and deodorizing method.
included_members.abstraction: Coandă-driven laminar air-sheet generation: Produce a continuous, wall-attached, high-velocity laminar sheet of air using geometry and nozzle orientation that leverage the Coandă effect.
included_members.label: Coandă-driven laminar air-sheet generation
included_members.description: Produce a continuous, wall-attached, high-velocity laminar sheet of air using geometry and nozzle orientation that leverage the Coandă effect.
included_members.explanation: Generates a laminar air sheet (Coandă effect) to lift/entrain particles via aerodynamic flow.

included_members.abstraction: Sustained, non-turbulent surface shear: maintain a non-turbulent, wall-attached airflow that applies gentle but persistent shear across fabric surfaces to detach dust, lint, and hair.
included_members.label: Sustained, non-turbulent surface shear
included_members.description: maintain a non-turbulent, wall-attached airflow that applies gentle but persistent shear across fabric surfaces to detach dust, lint, and hair.
included_members.explanation: Maintains attached airflow shear across fabric surfaces to detach dust/lint—air-driven entrainment mechanism.

nodes.name: Suction-based particle extraction
nodes.description: Apply localized vacuum or reduced pressure flow paths to pull particulates off fabric and convey them away from the cleaning zone.
idea_text: A laundry drum or chamber equipped with high-efficiency vacuum nozzles and brushes. Clothes are tumbled while a powerful vacuum system actively lifts and extracts dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial dry dirt from the fabric. This process also helps remove airborne particles and can extend the life of garments between full wet washes.

A garment cleaning chamber that exposes clothes to precisely tuned mechanical vibrations or sonic frequencies. These frequencies are engineered to resonate with the physical bonds between dirt particles and fabric fibers, effectively loosening and detaching dirt without requiring bulk water. The dislodged particles are then collected by a vacuum or filtration system.

Design a laundry appliance with a rotating drum or series of pads equipped with precisely engineered, fabric-safe micro-bristles and combs, mimicking insect grooming structures. As clothes tumble or pass through, these structures gently brush, comb, and scrape away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial grime from fabric fibers, collecting them in an integrated vacuum system, thus cleaning without water.

A garment cleaning system where a very fine, dry, and biodegradable micro-abrasive powder (e.g., cellulose beads) is gently dusted onto clothes. A precisely controlled, low-power pulsed laser beam then scans the fabric. The laser energy interacts with the micro-abrasive particles, causing them to gently 'lift' or 'etch' away dirt and grime from the fabric surface through localized photomechanical action. The dirty micro-abrasive is then vacuumed away, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.

A sealed garment cleaning chamber where clothes are suspended. An array of micro-jets or pulsators generates highly localized, tunable air pressure pulsations around individual fabric fibers. These rapid, non-linear air movements create micro-turbulences and pressure differentials that physically dislodge dry dirt, dust, and lint particles without harsh mechanical contact or significant bulk air movement. Dislodged particles are then quietly drawn into a filter system by a very gentle, continuous background flow.

Garments are treated with a dissolvable or detachable nanocoating that has a stronger affinity for dirt/oils than for fabric fibers. After wear, the garments are placed in a gentle tumbling drum or cabinet. A mild, fabric-safe trigger (e.g., a specific light wavelength, a slight humidity change, or a very mild vibration) causes the nanocoating to rapidly delaminate or de-bond from the fabric, encapsulating and releasing the accumulated dirt. The shed nanocoating and dirt particles are then collected by a vacuum and filter system, leaving clean fabric with no water.

A specialized cleaning plate or drum lining made of a piezoelectric material. Clothes are gently pressed against or tumbled on this surface. Interdigitated electrodes on the surface generate high-frequency SAWs that propagate along the interface with the fabric. These SAWs exert precise, localized mechanical forces on dirt particles at the fabric surface, effectively "sweeping" or "vibrating" them off without needing bulk water, solvents, or bulk ultrasonic cavitation. The dislodged dirt is collected by an integrated vacuum system.

A garment cleaning station equipped with a low-power, pulsed laser system. Optical sensors identify soiled areas, and the laser is precisely tuned (wavelength, pulse energy) to be selectively absorbed by common dirt, oils, or stain chromophores. The absorbed energy causes rapid, localized micro-vaporization or thermal decomposition of the contaminant, effectively "ablating" it from the fabric surface without heating or damaging the surrounding fibers. A gentle vacuum collects the resulting microscopic debris, providing an extremely targeted, water-free, and residue-free cleaning method.

A specialized laundry drum or cabinet with embedded micro-electrodes near the fabric surface. When clothes are present, a precisely controlled, short, high-energy electrical pulse is applied. This generates localized, micro-scale mechanical shockwaves within the fabric itself or at the fabric-dirt interface, effectively breaking the adhesive bonds of embedded dirt and grime without damaging the fibers. The dislodged particles are then removed by a gentle vacuum and filtration system, providing a water-free cleaning method that targets deeply embedded contaminants.

A highly specialized garment cleaning station equipped with a low-energy, broad, non-damaging ion beam. Optical sensors identify and map individual dirt particles or stains. The ion beam is then directed to these specific micro-regions, where the kinetic energy of the ions physically dislodges and sputters away the contaminant molecules from the fabric surface without damaging the fibers. A gentle vacuum system collects the sputtered debris, providing an ultra-precise, water-free, and residue-free spot cleaning method.

A flat cleaning surface or a drum lining integrated with an array of microscopic, fabric-safe MEMS actuators. When a garment makes contact, optical sensors identify individual dirt particles. The micro-actuators then precisely extend or vibrate locally, gently lifting or dislodging specific dirt particles from the fabric fibers. These particles are then drawn away by a localized micro-vacuum system, enabling highly targeted, dry, and extremely gentle particulate removal from clothing without water.

A garment cleaning system where clothes are briefly exposed to a very fine mist of a fabric-safe, non-toxic, supersaturated crystalline salt solution. Cycles of controlled humidity reduction and re-humidification are then applied in a dry chamber. As the salt crystals grow within the fabric pores and around dirt particles, they exert micro-mechanical stresses. When humidity changes, they re-crystallize or shrink, causing embedded dirt to physically detach from the fibers. The loosened dirt and salt residue are then removed by a gentle vacuum and filtration system, achieving cleaning with minimal water and no harsh chemicals.

nodes.name: Mechanical wave and vibration detachment
nodes.description: Use vibration, acoustic/ultrasonic excitation, or broadband mechanical waves (including embedded actuators) to break particle–fiber adhesion and shake particles free.
idea_text: A specialized garment cleaning chamber that briefly chills clothes to cryogenic temperatures (e.g., using a controlled blast of chilled air or liquid nitrogen vapor). This causes embedded dirt, chewing gum, or stubborn stains to become brittle, allowing them to be easily dislodged and vibrated or brushed off the fabric without the need for water or solvents.

A garment cleaning chamber that exposes clothes to precisely tuned mechanical vibrations or sonic frequencies. These frequencies are engineered to resonate with the physical bonds between dirt particles and fabric fibers, effectively loosening and detaching dirt without requiring bulk water. The dislodged particles are then collected by a vacuum or filtration system.

Develop garments or specialized fabric liners with embedded or woven piezoelectric fibers. When these garments are placed in a dry tumbling drum, the gentle mechanical motion of tumbling induces micro-vibrations within the fabric itself (due to the piezoelectric effect). These self-generated, high-frequency vibrations effectively loosen and dislodge dry dirt, dust, and lint particles from the fibers, which are then collected by an integrated vacuum and filter system within the drum, eliminating the need for water for general refreshing.

A garment cleaning chamber equipped with multi-modal transducers capable of generating a broadband spectrum of mechanical waves, including both compressional and shear waves, that propagate through the fabric. These complex vibrations are designed to physically agitate and break the adhesion of diverse dirt particles (dry dust, sticky grime) from fibers across various fabric types. Dislodged particles are then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration system, achieving dry cleaning without specific reliance on a single resonance.

A flat cleaning surface or a drum lining integrated with an array of microscopic, fabric-safe MEMS actuators. When a garment makes contact, optical sensors identify individual dirt particles. The micro-actuators then precisely extend or vibrate locally, gently lifting or dislodging specific dirt particles from the fabric fibers. These particles are then drawn away by a localized micro-vacuum system, enabling highly targeted, dry, and extremely gentle particulate removal from clothing without water.
idea_texts: A specialized garment cleaning chamber that briefly chills clothes to cryogenic temperatures (e.g., using a controlled blast of chilled air or liquid nitrogen vapor). This causes embedded dirt, chewing gum, or stubborn stains to become brittle, allowing them to be easily dislodged and vibrated or brushed off the fabric without the need for water or solvents.

A garment cleaning chamber that exposes clothes to precisely tuned mechanical vibrations or sonic frequencies. These frequencies are engineered to resonate with the physical bonds between dirt particles and fabric fibers, effectively loosening and detaching dirt without requiring bulk water. The dislodged particles are then collected by a vacuum or filtration system.

Develop garments or specialized fabric liners with embedded or woven piezoelectric fibers. When these garments are placed in a dry tumbling drum, the gentle mechanical motion of tumbling induces micro-vibrations within the fabric itself (due to the piezoelectric effect). These self-generated, high-frequency vibrations effectively loosen and dislodge dry dirt, dust, and lint particles from the fibers, which are then collected by an integrated vacuum and filter system within the drum, eliminating the need for water for general refreshing.

nodes.name: Brush, comb, and micro-projection grooming
nodes.description: Use bristles, combs, scraping edges, or micro-projections to mechanically lift, comb out, or scrape particulates from fibers; includes controlling contact depth and compliance.
idea_text: Design a laundry appliance with a rotating drum or series of pads equipped with precisely engineered, fabric-safe micro-bristles and combs, mimicking insect grooming structures. As clothes tumble or pass through, these structures gently brush, comb, and scrape away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial grime from fabric fibers, collecting them in an integrated vacuum system, thus cleaning without water.

A laundry appliance with internal surfaces or rotating pads featuring arrays of soft, fabric-safe micro-needles or textured micro-projections. As garments are gently tumbled or brushed against these surfaces, the micro-needles penetrate the weave, physically lifting and extracting deeply embedded dirt, dust, and particulate matter from the fabric pores without requiring water or harsh chemicals.

nodes.name: Tumbling and relative-motion agitation
nodes.description: Use drum rotation/impacts and controlled garment motion (including brush-assisted tumbling) to expose surfaces and generate repeated shear/peel events that loosen particles.
idea_text: A specialized tumbling drum system where clothes are cleaned with a mixture of tiny, reusable cryogel granules. These granules gently abrade the fabric, absorbing oils, dirt, and odor molecules. After the cycle, the granules are separated from the clothes, cleaned (e.g., by vacuuming or solvent bath), and reused, with no water used in the garment cleaning process itself.

A laundry drum or chamber equipped with high-efficiency vacuum nozzles and brushes. Clothes are tumbled while a powerful vacuum system actively lifts and extracts dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial dry dirt from the fabric. This process also helps remove airborne particles and can extend the life of garments between full wet washes.

Develop garments or specialized fabric liners with embedded or woven piezoelectric fibers. When these garments are placed in a dry tumbling drum, the gentle mechanical motion of tumbling induces micro-vibrations within the fabric itself (due to the piezoelectric effect). These self-generated, high-frequency vibrations effectively loosen and dislodge dry dirt, dust, and lint particles from the fibers, which are then collected by an integrated vacuum and filter system within the drum, eliminating the need for water for general refreshing.

Design a laundry appliance with a rotating drum or series of pads equipped with precisely engineered, fabric-safe micro-bristles and combs, mimicking insect grooming structures. As clothes tumble or pass through, these structures gently brush, comb, and scrape away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial grime from fabric fibers, collecting them in an integrated vacuum system, thus cleaning without water.

A garment chamber where clothes are exposed to precisely tuned RF or microwave fields. The frequency and power are optimized to selectively heat and slightly expand/soften the dirt particles or the interface layer between dirt and fabric, without significantly heating the fabric itself. This localized thermal stress, combined with gentle mechanical tumbling or air currents, causes the dirt to lose adhesion and be dislodged. A filtration system then collects the removed particles, providing a water-free cleaning method.

A laundry appliance with internal surfaces or rotating pads featuring arrays of soft, fabric-safe micro-needles or textured micro-projections. As garments are gently tumbled or brushed against these surfaces, the micro-needles penetrate the weave, physically lifting and extracting deeply embedded dirt, dust, and particulate matter from the fabric pores without requiring water or harsh chemicals.

A sealed garment cabinet or tumbling drum equipped with a heating and cooling system to create a controlled temperature gradient across the fabric surface in a dry environment. As garments are gently tumbled or suspended, the temperature gradient induces thermophoretic forces that gently drive fine dust, lint, and superficial particulate dirt away from the warmer fabric surface towards a colder collection plate or filter, effectively removing dry contaminants without water.

Design a laundry drum that tumbles clothes in a low-humidity environment, inducing an electrostatic charge on both fabric and dirt particles. The charged dirt particles are then attracted to an oppositely charged collector plate or filter within the drum, effectively "lifting" them off the fabric without water.

A sealed laundry drum lined with or containing pellets of a durable, fabric-safe solid catalyst (e.g., a noble metal or metal oxide catalyst). Clothes are tumbled in a precisely controlled, slightly humid or dry atmosphere containing a gentle oxidant (e.g., low concentration ozone or peroxide vapor). The catalyst promotes the gentle oxidation and breakdown of organic dirt, body oils, and odor molecules into simpler, volatile compounds (like CO2 and water vapor), which are then vented and filtered. This provides a dry, continuous, and chemical-free deep cleaning with no water requirement for the actual cleaning.

nodes.description: Use reusable pickup surfaces (micro/nano-structured adhesion or compliant charged contact arrays) that collect particulates by contact, plus mechanisms to move the pickup surface and release debris into a bin.
idea_text: A handheld device or an automated robotic system with a specialized roller or pad whose surface mimics the micro- or nano-structure of gecko feet. This roller would be gently passed over garments, picking up dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial grime through contact. The collected dirt would then be released from the roller's surface into a waste receptacle (e.g., by a slight change in angle or pressure), allowing the cleaning surface to be reused repeatedly without water or chemicals.

Design a laundry drum with an internal lining composed of a dense array of very fine, compliant, and electrically charged polymeric filaments or a specialized mesh. As clothes tumble, these filaments gently brush against the fabric, and the static charge passively attracts and entangles dry dust, lint, and pet hair. The collected debris adheres to the filaments, which are periodically retracted and vibrated or subjected to a reverse charge to release the accumulated dirt into a separate collection bin, providing a gentle, water-free dry cleaning and de-linting process.

nodes.description: Introduce solid media (pellets or added particles) that deliver localized impacts/abrasion or act as intermediaries to mechanically free embedded dirt without bulk liquid.

nodes.name: Particle capture, separation, and containment
nodes.description: Collect the removed particulates using filters, cyclones, traps, bins, cold capture surfaces, or purification stages to prevent redeposition and enable disposal.
idea_text: A laundry drum or chamber equipped with high-efficiency vacuum nozzles and brushes. Clothes are tumbled while a powerful vacuum system actively lifts and extracts dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial dry dirt from the fabric. This process also helps remove airborne particles and can extend the life of garments between full wet washes.

A specialized laundry chamber or drum designed with precisely positioned nozzles that generate high-velocity, controlled air vortices around and through the garments. These aerodynamic forces would gently lift and carry away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial particulate dirt from fabric fibers, collecting them in a filter system, effectively de-soiling clothes without any water.

Develop garments or specialized fabric liners with embedded or woven piezoelectric fibers. When these garments are placed in a dry tumbling drum, the gentle mechanical motion of tumbling induces micro-vibrations within the fabric itself (due to the piezoelectric effect). These self-generated, high-frequency vibrations effectively loosen and dislodge dry dirt, dust, and lint particles from the fibers, which are then collected by an integrated vacuum and filter system within the drum, eliminating the need for water for general refreshing.

A garment chamber where clothes are exposed to precisely tuned RF or microwave fields. The frequency and power are optimized to selectively heat and slightly expand/soften the dirt particles or the interface layer between dirt and fabric, without significantly heating the fabric itself. This localized thermal stress, combined with gentle mechanical tumbling or air currents, causes the dirt to lose adhesion and be dislodged. A filtration system then collects the removed particles, providing a water-free cleaning method.

A laundry appliance with internal surfaces or rotating pads featuring arrays of soft, fabric-safe micro-needles or textured micro-projections. As garments are gently tumbled or brushed against these surfaces, the micro-needles penetrate the weave, physically lifting and extracting deeply embedded dirt, dust, and particulate matter from the fabric pores without requiring water or harsh chemicals.

A cleaning chamber where garments are introduced and suspended on a precisely controlled air cushion (an "air film") generated from below. This eliminates friction and mechanical wear. While suspended, targeted, high-velocity air nozzles (acting as siphons or localized vacuums) are directed at the garment from above, actively lifting and extracting dry dust, lint, and superficial grime from the fabric fibers, collecting them in a filter system, all without water or direct contact.

A sealed garment cabinet or tumbling drum equipped with a heating and cooling system to create a controlled temperature gradient across the fabric surface in a dry environment. As garments are gently tumbled or suspended, the temperature gradient induces thermophoretic forces that gently drive fine dust, lint, and superficial particulate dirt away from the warmer fabric surface towards a colder collection plate or filter, effectively removing dry contaminants without water.

A garment refreshing cabinet where an internal electric field generates a controlled "ion wind" or electrohydrodynamic flow. This silent, gentle, localized air current is directed across the fabric surfaces, physically dislodging dry dust, lint, and carrying away odor molecules without any moving mechanical parts. The dislodged particles and odors are then collected by an integrated filter and purification system, providing a water-free and gentle cleaning method.

Design a laundry drum with an internal lining composed of a dense array of very fine, compliant, and electrically charged polymeric filaments or a specialized mesh. As clothes tumble, these filaments gently brush against the fabric, and the static charge passively attracts and entangles dry dust, lint, and pet hair. The collected debris adheres to the filaments, which are periodically retracted and vibrated or subjected to a reverse charge to release the accumulated dirt into a separate collection bin, providing a gentle, water-free dry cleaning and de-linting process.

A garment refreshing cabinet with internal curved surfaces and precisely angled air nozzles designed to exploit the Coandă effect. A continuous, laminar sheet of high-velocity air is generated and directed to flow smoothly over the garments. This non-turbulent, wall-attached airflow creates a gentle, continuous shear force across the fabric surfaces, effectively lifting and carrying away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial particulate matter without harsh mechanical contact. The dirt-laden air is then silently directed into a high-efficiency filter system, providing a very gentle, water-free cleaning and deodorizing method.

nodes.name: Multi-stage greywater treatment trains
nodes.description: Sequence multiple treatment steps to convert post-wash greywater into reuse-quality water.
idea_text: A low-water washing system that uses a mild, biodegradable solution containing engineered humic acid analogues or naturally derived humic substances. These compounds act as powerful chelating and dispersing agents, effectively binding to dirt, oils, and metal ions embedded in fabric. This complexation process makes the contaminants easier to rinse away with a minimal amount of water, which is then purified and recycled through a system optimized to separate the humic-dirt complexes.

A washing machine with an integrated, ultra-efficient closed-loop water purification system. After each wash cycle, the greywater undergoes micro-filtration, reverse osmosis, and UV sterilization, making it pristine and immediately reusable for the next load, virtually eliminating water discharge and demand.

nodes.name: Membrane-based purification modules
nodes.description: Use selective membranes to separate water from contaminants for reuse (e.g., distillation/forward osmosis/ion-exchange transport).
idea_text: A specialized washing unit where clothes are suspended in a minimal amount of slightly conductive water or a weak electrolyte solution. The chamber incorporates alternating cation and anion exchange membranes. By applying an electric current, charged dirt particles (ions) and dissolved impurities are drawn out of the fabric and across the membranes, leaving cleaner fabric and significantly purified water for near-complete reuse within the closed system.

A washing machine integrated with a membrane distillation unit. After an initial minimal-water wash, the greywater is fed into the membrane distillation system. Water vapor passes through the hydrophobic membrane, leaving all dissolved and suspended contaminants in the concentrated brine. This purified water is then condensed and immediately recycled for the next wash cycle, achieving ultra-high water recovery and significantly reducing fresh water intake.

A washing machine integrated with a forward osmosis system. After an initial, minimal-water wash cycle, the greywater (feed solution) is pumped to one side of an FO membrane. A highly concentrated, reusable draw solution is on the other side. Clean water is naturally pulled from the greywater through the membrane, leaving all contaminants and dirt in the concentrated feed solution, and the purified water is then recycled back into the wash system for continuous reuse, drastically reducing fresh water consumption.

nodes.name: Electrochemical pre-treatment and floc formation
nodes.description: Aggregate or transform contaminants into separable forms to simplify downstream separation and improve recycle quality.
idea_text: An advanced washing machine that incorporates an electrocoagulation system into its water purification loop. After a minimal initial wash with water, the greywater is treated with electrocoagulation to rapidly aggregate and remove dirt, dyes, and other contaminants. This pre-treatment significantly reduces the load on subsequent filtration, allowing the water to be recycled and reused much more efficiently for consecutive washes, minimizing fresh water intake.

nodes.name: In-line filtration and soil capture for recirculation
nodes.description: Filter, separate, and capture particulates/soils during circulation so cleaned liquid can be reused in a closed loop.
idea_text: A system where garments are briefly immersed in a minimal volume of a low-viscosity, fabric-safe MR fluid. A pulsed magnetic field is then applied, causing the fluid to momentarily thicken around the fabric fibers, effectively encapsulating and mechanically stressing embedded dirt and oil particles. When the field is removed, the fluid instantly thins, releasing the loosened dirt, which is then carried away by filtration. The fluid is continuously recycled and purified for subsequent uses with minimal loss and no water.

A minimal-water wash system where clothes are immersed in a very small volume of water containing a low concentration of cleaning agents. High-frequency acoustic transducers are precisely arrayed to generate acoustic radiation forces that gently 'push' and aggregate dirt particles within the water towards a specific collection zone or filter, without requiring bulk fluid flow or mechanical agitation of the clothes. This allows for highly efficient dirt removal from the water, enabling near-complete water recirculation and minimal fresh water input for effective cleaning.

A garment cleaning system that employs a fine mist of water containing specialized, fabric-safe, marine-derived or inspired chelating agents. These agents are designed to selectively bind to metallic ions, mineral deposits (e.g., from hard water stains), and certain organic pollutants commonly found in dirt and stains. Once chelated, the contaminants become more soluble or easily dislodged, allowing for effective removal with significantly reduced water rinsing, which is then filtered to remove the chelated compounds for safe disposal or recovery.

A sealed garment cabinet that uses a small, contained reservoir of water. This water is rapidly heated to generate superheated, dry steam (vapor without liquid droplets). idea_text: A controlled chamber system that applies a fine, non-toxic, biodegradable, and fabric-safe "bio-slime" (e.g., a hydrogel-based polymer with specific adhesive properties) mist onto clothes. This slime is engineered to be slightly adhesive to dirt and odor molecules. After a short dwell time, a second stage triggers a controlled 'shedding' or breakdown of the slime (e.g., via a pH change or mild vibration), causing it to detach from the fabric, carrying the trapped dirt and odors with it, into a collection system. The slime is then processed for disposal or regeneration, leaving clean, residue-free clothes with minimal water usage.

nodes.name: Low-water prewash and minimal-volume operation
nodes.description: Reduce the volume requiring purification using low-water prewash steps or minimal-liquid washing with recirculation.
idea_text: An advanced washing machine that incorporates an electrocoagulation system into its water purification loop. After a minimal initial wash with water, the greywater is treated with electrocoagulation to rapidly aggregate and remove dirt, dyes, and other contaminants. This pre-treatment significantly reduces the load on subsequent filtration, allowing the water to be recycled and reused much more efficiently for consecutive washes, minimizing fresh water intake.

A low-water garment cleaning chamber where clothes are immersed in a minimal volume of specialized, mildly aqueous solution. Fine, microscopic air bubbles are then introduced into the solution. These bubbles are engineered to selectively adhere to hydrophobic dirt, oils, and grease particles embedded in the fabric. The dirt-laden bubbles rise to the surface, forming a stable "froth" that is continuously skimmed off and filtered, effectively extracting contaminants from the garments with extremely low water usage and minimal mechanical agitation. The cleaned water is then recirculated.

nodes.name: Air-circulated sorbent capture
nodes.description: Circulate air across garments and route it through a sorbent/filtration medium so water/volatiles transfer into the air stream and are captured; includes sealed enclosure, airflow control, and sorbent regeneration.
idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet where clothes are hung. The cabinet incorporates a fan that circulates air through the garments and then through a bed of adsorptive material (e.g., activated carbon filters or zeolite beads). This system passively removes odors and fine dust particles from clothing, extending wear time between washes without using any water.

A sealed garment cabinet containing regenerable desiccant materials (e.g., advanced zeolites or MOFs) and a fan. Air is circulated through the garments and then over the desiccant bed. The desiccant actively pulls moisture (and dissolved body oils/odors) directly from the fabric into the air stream, and then adsorbs it. This dry extraction process cleanses and deodorizes garments without the use of water. The desiccant can then be heated to release the dirty moisture for disposal and regenerate for reuse.

A garment refreshing cabinet that utilizes a bed of regenerable, fabric-safe chemical sorbents (e.g., modified amines or Metal-Organic Frameworks). These sorbents are specifically engineered to reversibly bind volatile organic compounds (VOCs) responsible for odors. Air is circulated through the garments and then over the sorbent bed, trapping odors. The sorbent is then periodically regenerated (e.g., by heating or pressure swing), releasing concentrated odors for safe disposal, making this a highly efficient, water-free, and chemical-free deodorization system.

These sorbents are specifically engineered to reversibly bind volatile organic compounds (VOCs) responsible for odors. Air is circulated through the garments and then over the sorbent bed, trapping odors. The sorbent is then periodically regenerated (e.g., by heating or pressure swing), releasing concentrated odors for safe disposal, making this a highly efficient, water-free, and chemical-free deodorization system.
included_members.abstraction: Regeneration subsystem (thermal/pressure swing): A controlled process to desorb and concentrate captured volatiles from the sorbent, restoring capture capacity and producing a manageable waste stream for disposal or further treatment.
included_members.label: Regeneration subsystem (thermal/pressure swing)
included_members.description: A controlled process to desorb and concentrate captured volatiles from the sorbent, restoring capture capacity and producing a manageable waste stream for disposal or further treatment.
included_members.explanation: Thermal/pressure-swing desorption to restore sorbent capacity is part of sorbent regeneration within air-circulated capture systems.

nodes.name: Wicking/absorbent sheet extraction
nodes.description: Use a porous absorbent sheet/medium in contact with textiles to pull out water/soils via capillary action and sequestration; may include low-humidity/heat/agitation to drive transfer and embedded dose-limited chemistry.
idea_text: Disposable or reusable "wicking sheets" impregnated with a small amount of cleaning agent that are placed inside or alongside garments in a low-humidity tumbling drum or dedicated cabinet. These sheets actively draw moisture, body oils, and dissolved grime out of the garment fibers through capillary action, trapping them within the sheet and refreshing the clothing with minimal to no external water.

A low-water garment cleaning system utilizing a highly concentrated, non-toxic cleaning solution or a solid osmotic agent. Garments are placed in contact with this agent or solution, and due to the osmotic pressure difference, water (containing dissolved dirt and body oils from the fabric fibers) is drawn out of the fabric and into the concentrated medium, effectively cleaning the garment with minimal external water.

A specialized, highly reusable sheet or pad made from a superhydrophilic, finely textured material designed to be placed in a tumbling dryer or a dedicated refresh cabinet with clothes. During a brief cycle with a very fine, minimal mist of water, this sheet actively attracts and captures body oils, dissolved dirt, and fine particulate matter released from the garments. The superhydrophilic material "wicks" and holds these contaminants, effectively cleaning the clothes with minimal water, and the sheet is then rinsed clean for reuse.

nodes.name: Particulate carrier pickup with mechanical contact
nodes.description: Apply reusable or biodegradable particles that adsorb/bind soils (often aided by mild abrasion), use tumbling/agitation for repeated contact, then separate and regenerate/collect the particles.
idea_text: A specialized tumbling drum system where clothes are cleaned with a mixture of tiny, reusable cryogel granules. These granules gently abrade the fabric, absorbing oils, dirt, and odor molecules. After the cycle, the granules are separated from the clothes, cleaned (e.g., by vacuuming or solvent bath), and reused, with no water used in the garment cleaning process itself.

A garment cleaning system where a very fine, dry, and biodegradable micro-abrasive powder (e.g., cellulose beads) is gently dusted onto clothes. A precisely controlled, low-power pulsed laser beam then scans the fabric. The laser energy interacts with the micro-abrasive particles, causing them to gently 'lift' or 'etch' away dirt and grime from the fabric surface through localized photomechanical action. The dirty micro-abrasive is then vacuumed away, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.

A system that applies a fine mist containing microscopic, biodegradable, decellularized bio-scaffold particles onto clothes. These particles are engineered to have a high affinity for common organic dirt and odors. After a short dwell time in a low-humidity environment, a mild trigger (e.g., specific light, very gentle vibration) initiates the controlled degradation or detachment of the bio-scaffold, taking the encapsulated dirt and odor molecules with it into a collection system, leaving clean garments with minimal water usage.

nodes.name: Magnetically manipulated contaminant-binding particles
nodes.description: Use functionalized contaminant-binding carriers that are magnetically responsive to improve handling and recovery; includes agitation for pickup plus magnetic collection and regeneration.
idea_text: Develop a cleaning system that introduces microscopic, fabric-safe magnetic particles (e.g., in a fine mist or dry powder form) engineered to selectively adhere to dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on garments. After a brief tumbling period to ensure contact, a powerful, oscillating magnetic field is applied to pull these dirt-laden magnetic particles out of the fabric and into a collection chamber for separation and potential reuse.

A dry or minimal-mist garment cleaning system that introduces a fine, fabric-safe ferrofluid mist onto clothes. This ferrofluid is engineered to preferentially bind to or encapsulate dirt and oil particles. After a brief dwell time, a localized, oscillating magnetic field is applied. This causes the dirt-laden ferrofluid to be agitated, moved, and then drawn out of the fabric by the magnetic field onto a collection surface, or into a separation chamber, effectively extracting dirt without bulk water. The ferrofluid can then be regenerated and reused.

nodes.name: Removable coating/film capture with peel-off removal
nodes.description: Apply a temporary coating/film that preferentially binds/encapsulates soils, then solidify and remove it intact (peel/roll/delaminate), with containment and low-water processing/regeneration/disposal.
idea_text: A controlled chamber system that applies a fine, non-toxic, biodegradable, and fabric-safe "bio-slime" (e.g., a hydrogel-based polymer with specific adhesive properties) mist onto clothes. This slime is engineered to be slightly adhesive to dirt and odor molecules. After a short dwell time, a second stage triggers a controlled 'shedding' or breakdown of the slime (e.g., via a pH change or mild vibration), causing it to detach from the fabric, carrying the trapped dirt and odors with it, into a collection system. The slime is then processed for disposal or regeneration, leaving clean, residue-free clothes with minimal water usage.

Garments are treated with a dissolvable or detachable nanocoating that has a stronger affinity for dirt/oils than for fabric fibers. After wear, the garments are placed in a gentle tumbling drum or cabinet. A mild, fabric-safe trigger (e.g., a specific light wavelength, a slight humidity change, or a very mild vibration) causes the nanocoating to rapidly delaminate or de-bond from the fabric, encapsulating and releasing the accumulated dirt. The shed nanocoating and dirt particles are then collected by a vacuum and filter system, leaving clean fabric with no water.

nodes.name: Reusable contact surface transfer with continuous regeneration
nodes.description: Bring textiles into controlled contact with a high-affinity receiving surface (including stimulus-modulated adhesion) that picks up contaminants, then actively releases them to a receptacle while regenerating the surface for reuse.
idea_text: A specialized, highly reusable sheet or pad made from a superhydrophilic, finely textured material designed to be placed in a tumbling dryer or a dedicated refresh cabinet with clothes. During a brief cycle with a very fine, minimal mist of water, this sheet actively attracts and captures body oils, dissolved dirt, and fine particulate matter released from the garments. The superhydrophilic material "wicks" and holds these contaminants, effectively cleaning the clothes with minimal water, and the sheet is then rinsed clean for reuse.

A laundry appliance featuring a series of rotating polymer rollers whose surfaces are engineered to have a higher affinity for common dirt and oil molecules than for fabric fibers. As garments pass through, these rollers gently contact the fabric, transferring dirt and oils from the clothes onto their own surfaces. A secondary, integrated mechanism continuously cleans the rollers (e.g., with a scraper or micro-solvent spray which is then recovered), enabling continuous dirt removal from clothes without water.

A dry-cleaning appliance featuring rollers made from a "smart" polymer whose surface energy can be tuned. As garments pass through, a mild stimulus (e.g., a specific light wavelength) temporarily increases the roller's adhesion, causing it to pick up dirt and oils from the fabric. A different stimulus then reduces the adhesion, causing the collected dirt to release from the roller into a waste receptacle, making the roller self-cleaning and reusable for continuous water-free garment cleaning.

A dry-cleaning appliance featuring rollers made from a "smart" biomimetic polymer whose surface exhibits tunable, reversible bio-adhesion. As garments pass through, a mild, fabric-safe stimulus (e.g., a specific light wavelength, slight pH change, or mild electric field) activates the roller's surface to temporarily increase its adhesion, causing it to pick up a broad range of dirt, oils, and particulate matter from the fabric. A different stimulus then instantly reduces the adhesion, causing the collected dirt to release cleanly from the roller into a waste receptacle, making the roller self-cleaning and reusable for continuous, water-free garment cleaning.

nodes.name: Bubble-adhesion flotation removal
nodes.description: Generate microbubbles that selectively adhere to hydrophobic soils so buoyant complexes separate and are removed as froth, relying on interfacial adhesion/buoyancy rather than bulk agitation.
idea_text: A low-water garment cleaning chamber where clothes are immersed in a minimal volume of specialized, mildly aqueous solution. Fine, microscopic air bubbles are then introduced into the solution. These bubbles are engineered to selectively adhere to hydrophobic dirt, oils, and grease particles embedded in the fabric. The dirt-laden bubbles rise to the surface, forming a stable "froth" that is continuously skimmed off and filtered, effectively extracting contaminants from the garments with extremely low water usage and minimal mechanical agitation. The cleaned water is then recirculated.

nodes.name: Local mechanical/absorbent wipe-off
nodes.description: Physically remove mobilized/degraded soils by blotting/wiping with an absorbent medium instead of rinsing.
idea_text: A targeted spray or applicator pen that dispenses a concentrated blend of fabric-safe enzymes onto specific stains. After a short dwell time, the broken-down stain components can be wiped away with a damp cloth or absorbed by a dry, absorbent pad, eliminating the need for a full water wash for localized soiling.

A targeted handheld device or a small chamber with specialized electrodes. Garments, or specific soiled areas, are exposed to a minimal film of a slightly conductive, fabric-safe electrolyte solution. An electric current is then precisely applied, generating reactive species or directly oxidizing organic dirt, stains, and odor molecules on the fabric surface. These contaminants are electrochemically degraded into simpler, water-soluble, or volatile compounds, which are then wiped away or evaporated, minimizing water usage and avoiding harsh chemicals.

nodes.name: Stimuli-responsive swelling polymers as active soil ejectors
nodes.description: Hydrogels/brushes/microgels swell-shrink under pH/heat/humidity to push out soil.
idea_text: Develop cleaning agents or fabric coatings containing embedded or surface-applied smart polymers. When triggered (e.g., by a slight temperature change or pH adjustment in a low-humidity chamber with minimal mist), these polymers swell, physically pushing dirt and grime out of the fabric pores. Upon a reverse trigger, they contract, squeezing out any trapped impurities or dirty water, which is then collected, significantly reducing water usage for cleaning and rinsing.

nodes.name: Woven-in responsive microfibers for bulk fabric actuation
nodes.description: Dedicated responsive yarns swell/shrink to create displacement across textile structure.
idea_text: Garments are woven with a percentage of specialized, micro-scale stimuli-responsive fibers (e.g., pH or humidity-sensitive polymers). When the garment is exposed to a minimal, fine mist of water with a specific pH, these embedded fibers swell, physically pushing outwards and dislodging dirt particles from the fabric structure. A subsequent change (e.g., mild heating or pH neutralization) causes the fibers to shrink, releasing the loosened dirt, which is then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration system, achieving cleaning with very low water input.

nodes.name: Non-aqueous trigger modalities (light/vibration/humidity pulses)
nodes.description: Use light, mechanical vibration, or small humidity changes to activate coatings.
idea_text: Garments are treated with a dissolvable or detachable nanocoating that has a stronger affinity for dirt/oils than for fabric fibers. After wear, the garments are placed in a gentle tumbling drum or cabinet. A mild, fabric-safe trigger (e.g., a specific light wavelength, a slight humidity change, or a very mild vibration) causes the nanocoating to rapidly delaminate or de-bond from the fabric, encapsulating and releasing the accumulated dirt. The shed nanocoating and dirt particles are then collected by a vacuum and filter system, leaving clean fabric with no water.

nodes.name: Stimulus-coupled material integration and tuning
nodes.description: Embed/attach responsive particles and optically tune fabrics for reliable activation.
idea_text: Garments are manufactured with embedded or surface-applied microscopic, optically responsive elements (e.g., plasmonic nanoparticles or specialized polymer fibers). When placed in a dry cleaning chamber and illuminated with precisely tuned, non-damaging light wavelengths, these elements preferentially absorb energy. This causes rapid, localized micro-thermal expansion and contraction or phase change directly at the fabric-dirt interface, physically agitating and dislodging dirt particles. A gentle airflow then removes the loosened particles, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method leveraging engineered fabric properties.

nodes.name: Pressurized solvent dissolution in sealed vessel
nodes.description: Maintain super/near-critical solvent to dissolve oils under controlled P/T.
idea_text: A home appliance that uses recycled supercritical CO2 as the primary cleaning agent. Clothes are placed in a sealed chamber, CO2 is pressurized to its supercritical state, dissolves dirt, then is depressurized back to a gas for collection and reuse.

A closed-loop, high-pressure cleaning chamber that exposes garments to a minimal amount of near-critical water (e.g., 250-350 °C, 5-15 MPa). In this state, water effectively dissolves and cleanses organic dirt, oils, and greases from fabric fibers without harsh detergents. nodes.name: Temperature-gradient vapor condensation cleaning
nodes.description: Condense solvent vapor on cooler fabric, dissolve soils, then re-evaporate/sweep away.
idea_text: A compact garment cleaning appliance that uses a targeted, re-circulating vapor of a fabric-safe, low-boiling-point solvent (e.g., a modified alcohol or fluorocarbon). Clothes, or specific stained areas, are exposed to this vapor. The vapor condenses on the cooler fabric, dissolves oils and grime, and then re-evaporates, carrying the contaminants away to a recovery and purification system, leaving no residue and requiring no water for the cleaning process.
